    //! Opt-in native acceptance. Assets remain outside Git; no network or ROM download.
    use std::path::PathBuf;
    
    use lotus_protocol::envelope::SessionUuid;
    use lotus_session::native_session::{InputState, NativeSession};
    use lotus_session::supervisor::{HostConfig, Supervisor};
    
    fn config() -> (PathBuf, PathBuf, PathBuf) {
        let executable =
            PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("LOTUS_NATIVE_WORKER").expect("set LOTUS_NATIVE_WORKER"));
        let fixture = PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("LOTUS_FIXTURE").expect("set LOTUS_FIXTURE"));
        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("lotus-native-{}", SessionUuid::generate()));
        (executable, fixture, root)
    }
    
    #[tokio::test]
    #[ignore = "requires explicitly supplied native executable and homebrew fixture"]
    async fn native_lifecycle_frames_input_and_safe_reads() {
        let (executable, fixture, root) = config();
        let mut session = NativeSession::spawn(&executable, &root)
            .await
            .expect("native handshake");
        assert!(
            NativeSession::spawn(&executable, &root).await.is_err(),
            "exclusive root lock"
        );
        session.load(&fixture).await.expect("load homebrew");
        session
            .input(
                InputState {
                    buttons: 1,
                    ..InputState::default()
                },
                "scenario",
            )
            .await
            .expect("exclusive input");
        assert!(session.input(InputState::default(), "live").await.is_err());
        session
            .input(InputState::default(), "scenario")
            .await
            .expect("release buttons");
        let status = session.advance(60).await.expect("bounded run");
        assert_eq!(status["frames"], 60);
        let frames = session.capture().await.expect("native screens");
        assert_eq!(frames[0].bgra.len(), 400 * 240 * 4);
        assert_eq!(frames[1].bgra.len(), 320 * 240 * 4);
        let lease = frames[0].lease.clone();
        for _ in 0..3 {
            session.capture().await.expect("replace ring slots");
        }
        assert!(
            session.read_lease(&lease).is_err(),
            "slot sequence invalidates lease"
        );
        session.run().await.expect("start asynchronous run");
        for _ in 0..10 {
            let registers = session
                .registers(0)
                .await
                .expect("safe read while running/limiting");
            assert_eq!(registers["safe_point"], true);
            let pc = registers["registers"][15].as_u64().expect("PC") as u32;
            session
                .memory(pc, 4)
                .await
                .expect("mapped instruction memory");
            assert!(session.memory(pc, 4097).await.is_err(), "bounded read");
        }
        session.pause().await.expect("pause outside nested loop");
        let current = session.capture().await.expect("capture after pause");
        session.reset().await.expect("new epoch");
        assert!(
            session.read_lease(&current[0].lease).is_err(),
            "reset invalidates leases"
        );
        session.advance(2).await.expect("run after reset");
        let before_load = session.capture().await.expect("frame before reload");
        session.load(&fixture).await.expect("reload content");
        assert!(
            session.read_lease(&before_load[0].lease).is_err(),
            "load invalidates previous content leases"
        );
        session.stop().await.expect("clean shutdown");
        let mut second = NativeSession::spawn(&executable, &root)
            .await
            .expect("root lock released");
        second.load(&fixture).await.expect("second launch");
        second.advance(2).await.expect("second run");
        second.stop().await.expect("second shutdown");
        std::fs::remove_dir_all(root).expect("all instance files released");
    }
    
    #[tokio::test]
    #[ignore = "requires explicitly supplied native executable and homebrew fixture"]
    async fn four_native_workers_survive_forced_sibling_failure() {
        let (executable, fixture, root) = config();
        let mut tasks = Vec::new();
        for index in 0..4 {
            let executable = executable.clone();
            let fixture = fixture.clone();
            let root = root.join(index.to_string());
            tasks.push(tokio::spawn(async move {
                let mut session = NativeSession::spawn(&executable, &root)
                    .await
                    .expect("isolated native child");
                session
                    .load(&fixture)
                    .await
                    .expect("same read-only content");
                session.advance(30).await.expect("parallel emulation");
                let frames = session.capture().await.expect("private frame artifacts");
                if index == 0 {
                    session.run().await.expect("run during failure injection");
                    session.abort().await;
                    assert!(session.read_lease(&frames[0].lease).is_err());
                    assert!(session.status().await.is_err());
                } else {
                    session.advance(30).await.expect("surviving sibling");
                    session.stop().await.expect("clean sibling stop");
                }
                root
            }));
        }
        for task in tasks {
            let child_root = task.await.expect("worker test task");
            assert!(child_root.join("worker.stderr.log").exists());
        }
        std::fs::remove_dir_all(root).expect("job handles and locks released after crash");
    }
    
    #[tokio::test]
    #[ignore = "requires explicitly supplied native executable and homebrew fixture"]
    async fn supervisor_bounds_workers_and_retains_scoped_artifacts() {
        let (worker, fixture, root) = config();
        let mut host = Supervisor::new(HostConfig {
            worker,
            storage_root: root.clone(),
            assets: std::collections::BTreeMap::from([("fixture".into(), fixture)]),
            allow_control: true,
        })
        .expect("native host");
        assert!(host.create("../unapproved.3dsx").await.is_err());
        let mut sessions = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..4 {
            sessions.push(host.create("fixture").await.expect("within worker budget"));
        }
        assert!(
            host.create("fixture").await.is_err(),
            "fifth worker must be rejected before launch"
        );
        host.session(&sessions[0])
            .expect("owned session")
            .advance(2)
            .await
            .expect("native frames");
        let capture = host
            .capture(&sessions[0])
            .await
            .expect("immutable artifacts");
        for id in sessions {
            host.stop(&id).await.expect("stop owned worker");
        }
        assert!(host.read_artifact("file:///C:/Windows/win.ini").is_err());
        for artifact in capture {
            assert_eq!(
                host.read_artifact(&artifact.uri)
                    .expect("artifact survives worker stop")
                    .len(),
                artifact.bytes
            );
        }
        std::fs::remove_dir_all(root).expect("host releases all worker roots");
    }

    # 15 — Dependency-ordered implementation tickets
    
    Use one small PR per ticket unless two changes are tightly inseparable. `INT` = `integration` (AZAHAR), `EXP` = `experimental` (CITnLO), `RUST` = LOTUS. Every PR links its regression test and source SHA. Current implementation and remaining acceptance checks are recorded in [25 — Wave status](25-wave-status.md); tickets below retain their original requirements.
    
    ## Wave 0 — pin sources and reduce integration risk
    
    ### T00 [RUST] Repository skeleton and toolchain lock
    
    **Deliver:** Cargo workspace, empty crates, `rust-toolchain.toml`, source-version manifest, CI format/check. **Check:** `cargo test --workspace` passes; no network downloads at runtime. **Avoid:** implementing service APIs before machine boundary is known.
    
    ### T01 [INT] Fork/worktree policy and stock baseline
    
    **Deliver:** `integration` branch from selected upstream SHA, `experimental` from integration, immutable stock checkout; patch inventory; build matrix. **Check:** stock Azahar builds and launches homebrew fixture; revisions recorded. **Avoid:** moving branches as build inputs without pinned hashes.
    
    ### T02 [RUST] GPUI screen spike, no emulator
    
    **Deliver:** standalone GPUI app with generated native-resolution top/bottom images, scaling, touch coordinate tests, memory/perf observation. **Check:** 10-minute continuous updates, 4 simulated sessions, two high-DPI scale factors. **Avoid:** native Vulkan interop in this ticket.
    
    ### T03 [RUST] Protocol scaffold and supervisor stubs
    
    **Deliver:** envelope schema, handshake, typed status codes, local pipe/socket transport, mock worker, process lifecycle state machine and unit tests. **Check:** invalid messages rejected; worker crash detected; stale epoch rejected; GUI-independent CLI can query mock. **Avoid:** encoding C++ pointer values into protocol.
    
    ## Wave 1 — native Azahar worker
    
    ### T04 [INT] New CMake worker target
    
    **Files:** root `CMakeLists.txt`, `src/CMakeLists.txt`, new `src/ctr_worker`. **Deliver:** `ENABLE_CTR_WORKER=OFF` default; executable linked to native libs. **Check:** Qt-off/Libretro-off build; stock build behavior unchanged. **Avoid:** modifying `citra_libretro`.
    
    ### T05 [INT] Minimal headless frontend
    
    **Files:** `emu_window.h` adapter, worker main, required applet/image callbacks. **Deliver:** boot known `.3dsx`; emit lifecycle and error result. **Check:** no Qt/SDL windows, clean stop/restart; unsupported applets explicit. **Avoid:** assuming `Headless` provides screenshot capture.
    
    ### T06 [INT] Native frame output
    
    **Deliver:** software backend raw top/bottom buffers with format/orientation metadata and sequence/ring ownership. **Check:** compare stable images to stock Azahar, test stale leases and source layout; no use-after-free. **Avoid:** scaling images for capture or blocking core waiting on UI.
    
    ### T07 [INT] Input/audio adapters
    
    **Deliver:** buttons, touch, scripted-exclusive input channel; bounded audio ring, optional muted output; keyboard/applicant fallback events. **Check:** timed key/touch replay, output hashes, headless audio drain, device disconnect. **Avoid:** mixing live input into deterministic script.
    
    ### T08 [INT+RUST] Safe-point command queue + IPC integration
    
    **Files:** `core.cpp` pending work, worker queue, Rust transport client. **Deliver:** load/run/pause/reset/status/stop; bounded read-only register/memory inspection, notification waking. **Check:** concurrent read/control requests while frame limiter sleeps; no mutable-state cross-thread access. **Avoid:** claiming selected-core instruction steps until proven.
    
    ### T09 [INT+RUST] Per-instance roots and shutdown
    
    **Deliver:** private settings/save/cache/log paths, unique IPC endpoints, worker termination and recovery. **Check:** two workers simultaneously read same ROM but write separate saves; forced-kill of one does not damage other. **Avoid:** incomplete COW layered filesystem at this stage.
    
    ## Wave 2 — first useful new emulator
    
    ### T10 [RUST] GPUI worker display and session browser
    
    **Deliver:** streamed images, input routing, run control, lifecycle warnings, session switching/docking. **Check:** worker crash does not crash UI; touch mapping correct at zoom/HiDPI; only latest displayed frames consumed. **Avoid:** full-featured GPU panes before stable state snapshots.
    
    ### T11 [RUST] Headless CLI and fixture runner
    
    **Deliver:** `create/load/run_until/capture/stop`, scenario format, checkpoints, input lease, report manifest. **Check:** fixed homebrew demo has repeatable result across 3 runs and no unbounded scenario execution. **Avoid:** falsely labeling host timing as hardware time.
    
    ### T12 [RUST] Four-worker stress and failure injection
    
    **Deliver:** resource policy and unique artifact roots. **Check:** 4 workers run independent scenarios, one forced crash, no port/cache/saves collision. **Avoid:** unbounded trace memory per worker.
    
    ### T13 [RUST] MCP adapter
    
    **Deliver:** small typed tools for session/control/capture/queries, artifact resources, client permissions. **Check:** CLI/MCP parity and no access to arbitrary shell/filesystem. **Avoid:** direct MCP calls into Azahar UDP RPC.
    
    ## Wave 3 — targeted engineering debugger
    
    ### T14 [EXP] CPU/kernel/thread trace
    
    **Deliver:** pause reasons, SVC/IPC and thread events, register/disassembly snapshots, breakpoint tests. **Check:** deterministic crash fixture yields same stop reason/context; perf A/B. **Avoid:** global instruction-by-instruction logging.
    
    ### T15 [EXP] GPU event indices and command capture
    
    **Files:** `gpu.cpp`, `pica_core.cpp`; **deliver:** GSP command IDs, PICA command stream, per-draw identity with state/time. **Check:** draw IDs stable for selected test, capture matches actual pre-draw command, bounded loss accounting. **Avoid:** capture of live VRAM long after draw.
    
    ### T16 [EXP] Resource lineage and GPU image capture
    
    **Deliver:** texture/surface source versions, transfer events, native pixel/diff images, renderer sync. **Check:** CPU overwrite between two draws distinguishes resource versions, no false identical hashes. **Avoid:** equating host texture format with original 3DS bytes.
    
    ### T17 [RUST] Timeline and visual inspector panels
    
    **Deliver:** CPU/kernel/GPU lanes, draw-state diffs, texture/shader tables, snapshot selector, stable source labels. **Check:** 100k-event trace opens without blocking GPUI event loop; resource usage bounded. **Avoid:** expensive polling for hidden panels.
    
    ### T18 [RUST+EXP] Differential run analysis
    
    **Deliver:** aligned checkpoint, frame and draw structural diffs; report earliest reliable divergence; corpus runner across stock/integration/experimental. **Check:** synthetic deliberate divergence detected; no nondeterminism misdiagnosed as definite bug. **Avoid:** reliance solely on screenshot visual comparison.
    
    ## Wave 4 — accuracy research
    
    ### T19 [RUST/hardware] Coffeepot 3DS microbenchmark integration
    
    **Deliver:** physical-console harness/suite, metadata parser, timer overhead calibration, raw fixture corpus. **Check:** first 3 physical experiments reproduced in separate sessions and compared to Azahar. **Avoid:** crediting unrun code as hardware-verified.
    
    ### T20 [EXP] Expose timing assumptions
    
    **Deliver:** list of virtual tick/transfer completion assumptions, tracing of source parameters and output event times, configured deterministic ticks. **Check:** trace accounts for timing events with correct domains; regression suite unaffected when disabled. **Avoid:** replacing model with game-specific per-title waits.
    
    ### T21 [RUST/EXP] Independent PICA register/shader reference
    
    **Deliver:** Rust component able to parse selected command lists and execute a minimal shader/reference draw; differential fixtures. **Check:** known hardware outputs match, with errors cataloged; feature-gated and doesn't break integrated backend. **Avoid:** promising full PICA rasterizer on first PR.
    
    ### T22 [EXP] First measured GPU timing correction
    
    **Deliver:** one documented timing behavior modeled against isolated and held-out physical tests. **Check:** improved physical error on target cases without known regressions, release flag and confidence labels. **Avoid:** accuracy claims from host profiler measurements.
    
    ### T23 [RUST] CPU and memory reference emulator research track
    
    **Deliver:** small ARM11 interpreter/test harness, architectural conformance tests and cache/timing experiment plan. **Check:** instruction results match hardware cases; no requirement to boot games yet. **Avoid:** replacing working Dynarmic prematurely.
    
    ## Architectural decisions still to research
    
    - Exact worker ownership of separate renderer/audio threads; benchmark best race-free safe-point boundary.
    - Whether real renderer exports native screen buffers conveniently without render-to-surface changes.
    - Whether a shared immutable shader cache is safe across worker processes.
    - GPUI texture import API viability; postpone until native-frame pipeline has measured limitations.
    - Complete save-state fidelity across worker revisions; scripted checkpoint remains fallback.
    - Independent native firmware boot path and distribution constraints.
    
    ## PR review form
    
    For each ticket include: `source SHA`, `branch`, `touched native files`, `why implementation belongs here`, `feature flag`, `before/after command or screenshot artifact`, `tests performed`, `hardware verification status`, `host performance A/B`, `known risk`, `rollback`. See templates.

    [azahar]

    # Lotus — documentation index
    
    Start here. Terms are defined once in the [glossary](glossary.md); documents
    link to it instead of redefining them. Each topic below points at exactly one
    canonical document — when writing or updating docs, link rather than duplicate.
    
    ## What Lotus is
    
    A **developer-first 3DS emulator platform** for writing and debugging homebrew
    with agents. Today it is an instrumentation, debugging and MCP wrapper around
    modified Azahar: a Rust product (GPUI desktop, CLI, MCP, scenario runner,
    session supervisor) that launches isolated native worker processes, each an
    emulated Old 3DS. The eventual goal is to replace the Azahar-derived workers
    with a more hardware-accurate in-house emulator. Contract, users and success
    metrics: [01 — product contract](01-product-contract.md).
    
    ## What Lotus is not
    
    Not "the most accurate 3DS emulator", not a Citra reskin, not a new hardware
    model yet. Bootstrap non-goals (no full HLE rewrite, no custom JIT, no
    in-process multi-instance, no LAN listeners, no synchronized multiplayer):
    [01, non-goals](01-product-contract.md). Why an independent UI does not make it
    accurate: [11, the critical distinction](11-accuracy-research.md). Current
    build makes no accuracy claim: [20](20-native-baseline.md).
    
    ## Lotus and Azahar
    
    Azahar supplies the initial machine; Lotus selectively modifies it through
    **one fork with two branches** — `integration` (minimal native worker hooks)
    and `experimental` (tracing, debugger, accuracy experiments) — plus a detached
    `stock` checkout as a control. Branch policy and invariants:
    [03](03-azahar-branches.md). Planned source edits:
    [16 — patch blueprint](16-azahar-patch-blueprint.md). Currently applied
    patches and baselines: [20](20-native-baseline.md).
    
    ## What is CITnLO
    
    CITnLO (CITra n LOtus) is the **backend name for the `experimental` branch**,
    the future home of tracing/debugger/accuracy work; AZAHAR is the `integration`
    backend name. Today both branches share one pin, so the two builds are
    identical and carry no accuracy experiments. See
    [glossary → CITnLO](glossary.md), [03](03-azahar-branches.md),
    [20](20-native-baseline.md).
    
    ## How it works internally
    
    - **Process graph and ownership boundaries** — desktop/CLI/MCP → Rust session
      supervisor → per-instance workers; shared-memory frames, artifact store:
      [02](02-system-architecture.md).
    - **Native Azahar worker** — headless `EmuWindow`, emulation thread, control
      queue: [04](04-azahar-native-worker.md); what's actually merged:
      [21](21-native-control.md).
    - **IPC / session contract** — length-prefixed pipes, epochs, safe points:
      [06](06-ipc-and-session-contract.md), [18](18-control-pipes.md).
    - **GPUI desktop** — screens, input, sessions: [05](05-gpui-desktop.md),
      [24](24-desktop.md).
    - **Multi-instance and storage** — one process per console, private roots:
      [10](10-multi-instance-and-storage.md).
    - **Debugging** — CPU/kernel/memory: [07](07-debugger-core.md); GPU capture
      and tracing: [08](08-gpu-and-trace.md); MCP and scenarios:
      [09](09-mcp-and-scenarios.md), [22](22-scenario-runner.md),
      [23](23-local-mcp.md).
    - Workspace layout: `crates/` (protocol, session, trace, debugger, runner,
      hardware, accuracy, mcp, cli, desktop), `workers/` (azahar, native, oracle),
      `vendor/azahar` (pinned source).
    
    ## Future plans
    
    - **Milestones M0–M6** — exit gates from reproducible sources to the first
      hardware-verified accuracy gain: [13](13-build-test-release.md).
    - **Tickets T00–T23 in four waves** — dependency-ordered plan with status:
      [15](15-implementation-tickets.md); delivered so far:
      [25 — wave status](25-wave-status.md).
    - **Accuracy research path** — phases A–E, from cataloging Azahar's inherited
      assumptions to an independent PICA200 model and real firmware:
      [11](11-accuracy-research.md).
    - **Hardware validation** — physical Old 3DS microbenchmarks and evidence
      standards: [12](12-hardware-validation.md).
    - Remaining acceptance gaps (visible GPUI rendering, two-DPI interaction,
      audio playback, other platforms): [25](25-wave-status.md).
    
    ## Building on Windows
    
    Primary toolchain: Rust 1.98.1 `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` (GCC/MinGW-w64),
    CMake + Ninja. MSVC and other platforms are untested.
    
    ```powershell
    scripts/bootstrap.ps1
    scripts/smoke.ps1
    scripts/build-azahar.ps1 -Branch integration      # or experimental / stock -Oracle
    cargo test --locked --workspace
    ```
    
    Pins live in `config/pins.toml`; native builds use sibling worktrees
    (`azahar-stock`, `azahar-integration`, `azahar-experimental`), each with its
    own build cache and manifest. Full details: [17](17-scaffold-and-pins.md) and
    [13](13-build-test-release.md). Opt-in native tests:
    [21, reproduction](21-native-control.md).

    ## Documentation rules
    
    - Numbers `01`–`25` are stable identifiers; never renumber, never duplicate
      another document's content — link to it or to the glossary.
    - New documents get the next number and a row in the map above, plus any new
      terms in the glossary.
    - Keep claims labeled with the evidence vocabulary in the glossary; AGENTS.md
      governs everything not covered here.
    # Glossary
    
    Single source of truth for project terms. Other documents link here instead of
    redefining them. Numbered documents (`01`–`25`) keep their numbers as stable
    identifiers regardless of directory; prose references like "document 18" remain
    valid.
    
    ## Names
    
    **LOTUS**
    The product: a developer-first 3DS emulator platform for homebrew debugging
    with agents — Rust supervisor, GPUI desktop, CLI, MCP adapter and scenario
    runner, driving isolated native worker processes. LOTUS is also the name
    reserved for the future in-house emulation backend that replaces the
    Azahar-derived workers. Canonical: [01](01-product-contract.md),
    [02](02-system-architecture.md), [21](21-native-control.md).
    
    **AZAHAR**
    Backend name for a worker built from the `integration` branch of the Azahar
    fork: upstream-minimal native hooks, no accuracy experiments. Native backend
    identifier `azahar_native_software`. Canonical: [03](03-azahar-branches.md),
    [21](21-native-control.md).
    
    **CITnLO** (CITra n LOtus)
    Backend name for a worker built from the `experimental` branch: tracing,
    debugger controls and accuracy experiments live here. Both branches currently
    share one pin, so AZAHAR and CITnLO builds are identical today; no accuracy
    experiments exist yet. Canonical: [03](03-azahar-branches.md),
    [17](17-scaffold-and-pins.md), [20](20-native-baseline.md).
    
    ## Branches and sources
    
    **integration** — upstream-tracking branch carrying only the minimal native
    worker/front-end hooks, adapters and proven fixes. Regular upstream merges;
    no guest-timing changes without evidence. [03](03-azahar-branches.md)
    
    **experimental** — derived from `integration`; structured tracing, debugger
    controls, snapshot and timing experiments. Never merged wholesale into
    `integration`. [03](03-azahar-branches.md)
    
    **stock** — detached, unmodified upstream checkout used as an independent
    control/oracle, not a maintained branch. [03](03-azahar-branches.md),
    [20](20-native-baseline.md)
    
    **Pin** — immutable commit SHA recorded in `config/pins.toml`; builds refuse
    moving or dirty inputs. [17](17-scaffold-and-pins.md)
    
    ## Runtime concepts
    
    **Worker** (`ctr-worker`) — one OS process per emulated console; a headless
    native C++ frontend over Azahar's `Core::System`, no Qt/SDL/Libretro.
    [04](04-azahar-native-worker.md)
    
    **Supervisor / session** — Rust process manager owning worker lifetimes,
    private storage roots, IPC endpoints and quotas. [02](02-system-architecture.md),
    [10](10-multi-instance-and-storage.md)
    
    **Safe point** — the emulation-thread drain point (`ProcessPendingWork` plus
    `NotifyPendingWork`) where queued control/debug commands execute; no thread
    reads mutable emulated state elsewhere. [06](06-ipc-and-session-contract.md),
    [16](16-azahar-patch-blueprint.md)
    
    **Epoch** — monotonically increasing state-generation counter; references from
    an older epoch are rejected. Incremented on load/reset/restore.
    [06](06-ipc-and-session-contract.md)
    
    **Frame ring / LTRF slots** — three reusable per-screen file slots carrying a
    32-byte header and native BGRA8 pixels; leases invalidated by reset/crash.
    [21](21-native-control.md)
    
    **Scenario** — declarative bounded run: start state, input ownership,
    checkpoints, stop condition, capture policy, assertions. [09](09-mcp-and-scenarios.md),
    [22](22-scenario-runner.md)
    
    ## Planning vocabulary
    
    **Wave / ticket** — dependency-ordered implementation plan; tickets `T00`–`T23`,
    scoped `INT` (integration), `EXP` (experimental), `RUST` (LOTUS).
    [15](15-implementation-tickets.md)
    
    **Milestone M0–M6** — release exit gates, from reproducible sources to the
    first hardware-verified accuracy gain. [13](13-build-test-release.md)
    
    **Accuracy phases A–E** — research path from cataloging inherited assumptions
    to real firmware execution. [11](11-accuracy-research.md)
    
    ## Evidence and time
    
    **Evidence labels** — `verified compiled`, `verified emulator`,
    `verified hardware`, `source inspected`, `proposed`. Required on every claim;
    no unverifiable check marks. [14](14-sources-and-evidence.md), AGENTS.md
    
    **Time domains** — guest ticks (emulator), host monotonic ns, and measured
    hardware times are never interchangeable. [02](02-system-architecture.md),
    [12](12-hardware-validation.md)
    
    **Old 3DS** — default target machine. New 3DS is a later, explicitly labeled
    profile. [01](01-product-contract.md), [11](11-accuracy-research.md)

    //! Bounded bridge between GPUI and the native supervisor; no emulation on UI thread.
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::io;
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
    use std::sync::mpsc::{self, SyncSender, TryRecvError};
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
    use std::thread::JoinHandle;
    use std::time::Duration;
    
    use lotus_session::native_session::{Frame, InputState};
    use lotus_session::supervisor::{HostConfig, Supervisor};
    use lotus_session::SessionState;
    
    #[derive(Clone)]
    pub enum Command {
        Create(String),
        Select(String),
        Play(String),
        Pause(String),
        Reset(String),
        Stop(String),
        Abort(String),
    }
    #[derive(Default)]
    pub struct SessionView {
        pub id: String,
        pub state: String,
        pub frame: u64,
        pub images: Option<Vec<Frame>>,
        pub playing: bool,
        pub error: String,
    }
    #[derive(Default)]
    pub struct Update {
        pub sessions: BTreeMap<String, SessionView>,
        pub error: String,
        pub selected: String,
    }
    
    /// Snapshots replace older frames; complete input states coalesce independently of commands.
    pub struct DesktopController {
        pub commands: SyncSender<Command>,
        pub latest: Arc<Mutex<Update>>,
        pub input: Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, InputState>>>,
        shutdown: Arc<AtomicBool>,
        thread: Option<JoinHandle<()>>,
    }
    
    impl DesktopController {
        pub fn start(config: HostConfig) -> io::Result<Self> {
            let mut host = Supervisor::new(config)?;
            let (sender, receiver) = mpsc::sync_channel(32);
            let latest = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Update::default()));
            let input: Arc<Mutex<BTreeMap<String, InputState>>> = Arc::default();
            let published = latest.clone();
            let pending_input = input.clone();
            let shutdown = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
            let requested_shutdown = shutdown.clone();
            let thread = std::thread::Builder::new()
                .name("lotus-supervisor".into())
                .spawn(move || {
                    let runtime = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().expect("supervisor runtime");
                    runtime.block_on(async move {
                        let mut selected = String::new();
                        let mut playing: BTreeMap<String, bool> = BTreeMap::new();
                        loop {
                            if requested_shutdown.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
                                break;
                            }
                            let mut connected = true;
                            for _ in 0..32 {
                                let command = match receiver.try_recv() {
                                    Ok(command) => command,
                                    Err(TryRecvError::Empty) => break,
                                    Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected) => {
                                        connected = false;
                                        break;
                                    }
                                };
                                let result: io::Result<()> = async {
                                    match command {
                                        Command::Create(asset) => {
                                            let id = host.create(&asset).await?;
                                            playing.insert(id.clone(), false);
                                            if let Ok(mut update) = published.lock() {
                                                update.sessions.insert(
                                                    id.clone(),
                                                    SessionView {
                                                        id: id.clone(),
                                                        state: "paused".into(),
                                                        ..SessionView::default()
                                                    },
                                                );
                                            }
                                            selected = id;
                                            if let Ok(mut update) = published.lock() {
                                                update.selected = selected.clone();
                                            }
                                        }
                                        Command::Select(id) => {
                                            selected = id;
                                            if let Ok(mut update) = published.lock() {
                                                update.selected = selected.clone();
                                            }
                                        }
                                        Command::Play(id) => {
                                            host.require_control()?;
                                            host.session(&id)?.run().await?;
                                            playing.insert(id, true);
                                        }
                                        Command::Pause(id) => {
                                            host.require_control()?;
                                            playing.insert(id.clone(), false);
                                            host.session(&id)?.pause().await?;
                                        }
                                        Command::Reset(id) => {
                                            host.require_control()?;
                                            playing.insert(id.clone(), false);
                                            host.session(&id)?.pause().await?;
                                            host.session(&id)?.reset().await?;
                                        }
                                        Command::Stop(id) => {
                                            playing.remove(&id);
                                            let result = host.stop(&id).await;
                                            if let Ok(mut update) = published.lock() {
                                                update.sessions.remove(&id);
                                            }
                                            result?;
                                        }
                                        Command::Abort(id) => {
                                            host.require_control()?;
                                            host.session(&id)?.abort().await;
                                            playing.insert(id, false);
                                        }
                                    }
                                    Ok(())
                                }
                                .await;
                                if let Err(error) = result {
                                    if let Ok(mut update) = published.lock() {
                                        update.error = error.to_string();
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            if !connected {
                                break;
                            }
                            let inputs = pending_input
                                .lock()
                                .map(|mut states| std::mem::take(&mut *states))
                                .unwrap_or_default();
                            for (id, state) in inputs {
                                if let Ok(session) = host.session(&id) {
                                    let _ = session.input(state, "live").await;
                                }
                            }
                            for id in host.sessions() {
                                let result = async {
                                    let session = host.session(&id)?;
                                    if session.state() == SessionState::Crashed {
                                        return Err(io::Error::other(
                                            "Worker crashed; stop it to release this slot.",
                                        ));
                                    }
                                    let status = session.status().await?;
                                    let frame = status["frames"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0);
                                    if playing.get(&id) == Some(&true)
                                        && session.state() == SessionState::Paused
                                    {
                                        session.run().await?;
                                    }
                                    let images = if id == selected && frame > 0 {
                                        Some(session.capture().await?)
                                    } else {
                                        None
                                    };
                                    Ok((
                                        frame,
                                        format!("{:?}", session.state()).to_lowercase(),
                                        images,
                                    ))
                                }
                                .await;
                                if let Ok(mut update) = published.lock() {
                                    if let Some(view) = update.sessions.get_mut(&id) {
                                        match result {
                                            Ok((frame, state, images)) => {
                                                view.frame = frame;
                                                view.state = state;
                                                if images.is_some() {
                                                    view.images = images;
                                                }
                                                view.error.clear();
                                            }
                                            Err(error) => {
                                                view.error = error.to_string();
                                                view.state = "crashed".into();
                                                view.images = None;
                                                playing.insert(id.clone(), false);
                                            }
                                        }
                                        view.playing = playing.get(&id) == Some(&true);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(33)).await;
                        }
                        for id in host.sessions() {
                            let _ = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(3), host.stop(&id)).await;
                        }
                    });
                })?;
            Ok(Self {
                commands: sender,
                latest,
                input,
                shutdown,
                thread: Some(thread),
            })
        }
    }
    
    impl Drop for DesktopController {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            self.shutdown.store(true, Ordering::Release);
            if let Some(thread) = self.thread.take() {
                let _ = thread.join();
            }
        }
    }
    //! Native controller acceptance without a GUI automation dependency.
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::path::PathBuf;
    use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
    
    use lotus_desktop::desktop_controller::{Command, DesktopController, Update};
    use lotus_protocol::envelope::SessionUuid;
    use lotus_session::supervisor::HostConfig;
    
    fn wait(controller: &DesktopController, predicate: impl Fn(&Update) -> bool) {
        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(35);
        loop {
            {
                let state = controller.latest.lock().expect("controller snapshot");
                if predicate(&state) {
                    return;
                }
            }
            assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "controller acceptance deadline");
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
        }
    }
    
    #[test]
    #[ignore = "requires external native worker and homebrew fixture"]
    fn controller_streams_switches_resets_and_stops_native_sessions() {
        let worker = PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("LOTUS_NATIVE_WORKER").expect("native worker"));
        let fixture = PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("LOTUS_FIXTURE").expect("fixture"));
        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("lotus-controller-{}", SessionUuid::generate()));
        let controller = DesktopController::start(HostConfig {
            worker,
            storage_root: root.clone(),
            assets: BTreeMap::from([("fixture".into(), fixture)]),
            allow_control: true,
        })
        .expect("background controller");
        controller
            .commands
            .send(Command::Create("fixture".into()))
            .expect("create first");
        wait(&controller, |state| state.sessions.len() == 1);
        let first = controller.latest.lock().expect("snapshot").selected.clone();
        controller
            .commands
            .send(Command::Play(first.clone()))
            .expect("play first");
        wait(&controller, |state| {
            state
                .sessions
                .get(&first)
                .is_some_and(|session| session.images.is_some())
        });
        controller
            .commands
            .send(Command::Create("fixture".into()))
            .expect("create second");
        wait(&controller, |state| {
            state.sessions.len() == 2 && state.selected != first
        });
        let second = controller.latest.lock().expect("snapshot").selected.clone();
        controller
            .commands
            .send(Command::Play(second.clone()))
            .expect("play second");
        wait(&controller, |state| {
            state
                .sessions
                .get(&second)
                .is_some_and(|session| session.images.is_some())
        });
        controller
            .commands
            .send(Command::Select(first.clone()))
            .expect("switch session");
        wait(&controller, |state| state.selected == first);
        controller
            .commands
            .send(Command::Abort(second.clone()))
            .expect("inject worker failure");
        wait(&controller, |state| {
            state
                .sessions
                .get(&second)
                .is_some_and(|session| session.state == "crashed" && session.images.is_none())
        });
        controller
            .commands
            .send(Command::Reset(first.clone()))
            .expect("reset selected");
        wait(&controller, |state| {
            state
                .sessions
                .get(&first)
                .is_some_and(|session| session.frame == 0 && !session.playing)
        });
        controller
            .commands
            .send(Command::Stop(first.clone()))
            .expect("stop selected");
        wait(&controller, |state| !state.sessions.contains_key(&first));
        drop(controller); // Releases the crashed second worker and all locks before returning.
        std::fs::remove_dir_all(root).expect("controller releases workers, logs and locks on close");
    }
    # LOTUS desktop
    
    The GPUI desktop consumes the shared native supervisor through a background
    controller. UI commands have a 32-entry bound. Complete input states coalesce
    separately, so key/touch releases do not depend on command-queue space. Latest
    snapshots replace old images; only the selected worker is captured. At most four
    sessions and eight native CPU images are retained, with no frame history.
    
    Launch with a local host JSON ([23](23-local-mcp.md)). `New: <asset>` loads an
    approved asset paused. Session rows select workers. Run/Pause, Reset and Stop
    control the selection. Zoom toggles 1x/1.5x; Dock screens toggles stacked/side-by-side.
    Keyboard: Z/X → A/B, A/S → X/Y, arrows, Q/W → L/R, Enter/Backspace → Start/Select.
    Click/drag the bottom screen for touch. Focus loss, deactivation, selection and
    layout changes release input. GPUI logical coordinates use the image's actual
    layout rectangle; simulated 1.25x/2x DPI inversion tests cover native corners.
    
    Worker failures clear displayed pixels and show a lifecycle warning. Other
    workers continue in their processes. Closing the controller stops its workers,
    with a three-second stop deadline per worker and job termination as fallback.
    An already pending native exchange can take up to its 30-second deadline.
    
    **Verified compiled**, pinned GPUI/Windows GNU. **Verified emulator** without UI
    automation: `native_controller` tests two sessions, frame streaming, switching,
    reset, sibling crash isolation, stop and close cleanup.
    Visible rendering, interactive input and actual two-DPI acceptance are deferred
    at the user's instruction to continue without Computer Use. Do not count them as
    verified. Accelerated rendering, host audio playback and other platforms remain
    untested.
    
    Source: `desktop::{desktop_controller,screen_geometry}`, desktop `main.rs`,
    `session::{supervisor,native_session}`. Primary GPUI APIs at its pinned source:
    `elements/{img,canvas}.rs`, `assets.rs` (`RenderImage` BGRA), `app/context.rs`
    (window activation/focus). Rollback: run CLI/MCP instead; no GUI is required for
    native scenarios.

    .SYNOPSIS
        Runs the fast checks: build, tests, formatter, clippy, CLI and pins.

        This is the check that a fresh checkout is healthy. It does not need a

    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [switch]$SkipBuild
    )
    
    # Native tools write progress to stderr; that must not be treated as a
    # terminating error. Failures are detected through the exit codes.
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    if (Get-Variable -Name PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
    }
    $root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
    
    function Invoke-Step {
        param(
            [string]$Name,
            [scriptblock]$Action
        )
    
        Write-Host "==> $Name" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        & $Action
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Host "FAILED: $Name" -ForegroundColor Red
            exit 1
        }
    }
    
    if (-not $SkipBuild) {
        Invoke-Step -Name 'cargo build' -Action {
            cargo build --manifest-path (Join-Path $root 'Cargo.toml') 2>&1 | Out-Host
        }
    }
    
    Invoke-Step -Name 'cargo test' -Action {
        cargo test --manifest-path (Join-Path $root 'Cargo.toml') --workspace 2>&1 | Out-Host
    }
    
    Invoke-Step -Name 'cargo fmt --check' -Action {
        cargo fmt --manifest-path (Join-Path $root 'Cargo.toml') --all -- --check 2>&1 | Out-Host
    }
    
    Invoke-Step -Name 'cargo clippy' -Action {
        cargo clippy --manifest-path (Join-Path $root 'Cargo.toml') --workspace --all-targets 2>&1 | Out-Host
    }
    
    Invoke-Step -Name 'ctr-cli version' -Action {
        & (Join-Path $root 'target\debug\ctr-cli.exe') version 2>&1 | Out-Host
    }
    
    Invoke-Step -Name 'pin verification' -Action {
        & (Join-Path $root 'scripts\verify-pins.ps1') 2>&1 | Out-Host
    }
    
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'Smoke checks passed.' -ForegroundColor Green
    exit 0

    //! LOTUS native session browser. GPUI only consumes owned snapshots.
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
    use std::time::Duration;
    
    use gpui::{
        App, AppContext, Bounds, Context, FocusHandle, InteractiveElement, IntoElement, KeyDownEvent,
        KeyUpEvent, MouseButton, MouseDownEvent, MouseMoveEvent, ParentElement, Render, RenderImage,
        SharedString, StatefulInteractiveElement, Styled, Window, WindowBounds, WindowOptions,
    };
    use image::{Frame, RgbaImage};
    use lotus_desktop::desktop_controller::{Command, DesktopController};
    use lotus_desktop::screen_geometry::TouchTransform;
    use lotus_session::native_session::InputState;
    use lotus_session::supervisor::HostConfig;
    
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct SessionView {
        state: String,
        frame: u64,
        playing: bool,
        error: String,
        images: Vec<Arc<RenderImage>>,
    }
    #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
    enum Layout {
        Stacked,
        SideBySide,
    }
    struct LotusWindow {
        controller: Option<DesktopController>,
        assets: Vec<String>,
        sessions: BTreeMap<String, SessionView>,
        selected: String,
        last_actor_selected: String,
        focus: FocusHandle,
        input: InputState,
        bottom_rect: Arc<Mutex<Option<TouchTransform>>>,
        zoom: f32,
        layout: Layout,
        error: String,
    }
    
    impl LotusWindow {
        fn new(config: Option<HostConfig>, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut Context<Self>) -> Self {
            let focus = cx.focus_handle();
            window.focus(&focus, cx);
            cx.on_blur(&focus, window, |view, _, _| view.release_input())
                .detach();
            cx.observe_window_activation(window, |view, window, _| {
                if !window.is_window_active() {
                    view.release_input();
                }
            })
            .detach();
            cx.spawn(async move |this, cx| loop {
                cx.background_executor()
                    .timer(Duration::from_millis(33))
                    .await;
                if this
                    .update(cx, |view, cx| {
                        view.poll();
                        cx.notify();
                    })
                    .is_err()
                {
                    break;
                }
            })
            .detach();
            let assets = config
                .as_ref()
                .map(|config| config.assets.keys().cloned().collect())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            let (controller, error) = match config.map(DesktopController::start).transpose() {
                Ok(controller) => (controller, String::new()),
                Err(error) => (None, error.to_string()),
            };
            Self {
                controller,
                assets,
                sessions: BTreeMap::new(),
                selected: String::new(),
                last_actor_selected: String::new(),
                focus,
                input: InputState::default(),
                bottom_rect: Arc::default(),
                zoom: 1.0,
                layout: Layout::Stacked,
                error,
            }
        }
    
        fn send(&mut self, command: Command) {
            if let Some(controller) = &self.controller {
                if let Err(error) = controller.commands.try_send(command) {
                    self.error = format!("Control busy: {error}");
                }
            }
        }
    
        fn poll(&mut self) {
            let Some(controller) = &self.controller else {
                return;
            };
            let Ok(mut update) = controller.latest.lock() else {
                return;
            };
            self.error = update.error.clone();
            if update.selected != self.last_actor_selected {
                if let Ok(mut inputs) = controller.input.lock() {
                    if !self.selected.is_empty() {
                        inputs.insert(self.selected.clone(), InputState::default());
                    }
                }
                self.input = InputState::default();
                self.selected = update.selected.clone();
                self.last_actor_selected = update.selected.clone();
            }
            self.sessions
                .retain(|id, _| update.sessions.contains_key(id));
            for (id, snapshot) in &mut update.sessions {
                let view = self.sessions.entry(id.clone()).or_default();
                view.state = snapshot.state.clone();
                view.frame = snapshot.frame;
                view.playing = snapshot.playing;
                view.error = snapshot.error.clone();
                if !view.error.is_empty() {
                    view.images.clear();
                }
                if let Some(frames) = snapshot.images.take() {
                    view.images = frames
                        .into_iter()
                        .map(|frame| {
                            let image =
                                RgbaImage::from_raw(frame.lease.width, frame.lease.height, frame.bgra)
                                    .expect("supervisor validated exact image dimensions");
                            Arc::new(RenderImage::new(vec![Frame::new(image)]))
                        })
                        .collect();
                }
            }
        }
    
        fn publish_input(&mut self) {
            if let Some(controller) = &self.controller {
                if let Ok(mut inputs) = controller.input.lock() {
                    if self.sessions.contains_key(&self.selected) {
                        inputs.insert(self.selected.clone(), self.input);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        fn release_input(&mut self) {
            self.input = InputState::default();
            self.publish_input();
        }
        fn select(&mut self, id: String) {
            self.release_input();
            self.selected = id.clone();
            self.send(Command::Select(id));
        }
        fn key(&mut self, key: &str, down: bool) {
            let mask = match key {
                "z" => 1,
                "x" => 2,
                "a" => 4,
                "s" => 8,
                "up" => 16,
                "down" => 32,
                "left" => 64,
                "right" => 128,
                "q" => 256,
                "w" => 512,
                "enter" => 1024,
                "backspace" => 2048,
                _ => return,
            };
            if down {
                self.input.buttons |= mask;
            } else {
                self.input.buttons &= !mask;
            }
            self.publish_input();
        }
        fn touch(&mut self, x: f32, y: f32) {
            let coordinate = self
                .bottom_rect
                .lock()
                .ok()
                .and_then(|rect| rect.as_ref().and_then(|rect| rect.map_logical(x, y)));
            if let Some((x, y)) = coordinate {
                self.input.x = x;
                self.input.y = y;
                self.input.touch = true;
            } else {
                self.input.touch = false;
            }
            self.publish_input();
        }
    }
    
    fn button(
        label: &'static str,
        command: Command,
        cx: &mut Context<LotusWindow>,
    ) -> impl IntoElement {
        gpui::div()
            .id(label)
            .px_3()
            .py_1()
            .rounded_sm()
            .bg(gpui::rgb(0x353947))
            .child(label)
            .on_click(cx.listener(move |view, _, _, _| view.send(command.clone())))
    }

    //! Local host policy: approved assets, four worker slots, bounded artifacts.
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::fs;
    use std::io;
    use std::path::PathBuf;
    
    use lotus_protocol::envelope::SessionUuid;
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    
    use crate::native_session::NativeSession;
    
    pub const MAX_WORKERS: usize = 4;
    pub const MAX_ARTIFACTS: usize = 128;
    
    /// Host configuration, never accepted as a tool-call argument.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub struct HostConfig {
        pub worker: PathBuf,
        pub storage_root: PathBuf,
        pub assets: BTreeMap<String, PathBuf>,
        #[serde(default)]
        pub allow_control: bool,
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct Artifact {
        pub uri: String,
        pub screen: String,
        pub width: u32,
        pub height: u32,
        pub bytes: usize,
        pub sha256: String,
    }
    
    /// No shell execution, arbitrary caller paths or remote listener.
    pub struct Supervisor {
        config: HostConfig,
        sessions: BTreeMap<String, NativeSession>,
        artifacts: BTreeMap<String, (Artifact, PathBuf)>,
    }
    
    impl Supervisor {
        pub fn new(mut config: HostConfig) -> io::Result<Self> {
            config.worker = config.worker.canonicalize()?;
            for path in config.assets.values_mut() {
                *path = path.canonicalize()?;
            }
            fs::create_dir_all(&config.storage_root)?;
            config.storage_root = config.storage_root.canonicalize()?;
            Ok(Self {
                config,
                sessions: BTreeMap::new(),
                artifacts: BTreeMap::new(),
            })
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn sessions(&self) -> Vec<String> {
            self.sessions.keys().cloned().collect()
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn assets(&self) -> Vec<String> {
            self.config.assets.keys().cloned().collect()
        }
    
        pub fn require_control(&self) -> io::Result<()> {
            if self.config.allow_control {
                Ok(())
            } else {
                Err(io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                    "host has not enabled control for this client",
                ))
            }
        }
    
        pub async fn create(&mut self, asset: &str) -> io::Result<String> {
            self.require_control()?;
            if self.sessions.len() >= MAX_WORKERS {
                return Err(io::Error::other("four-worker resource limit"));
            }
            let content = self.config.assets.get(asset).ok_or_else(|| {
                io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "unknown asset handle")
            })?;
            let id = SessionUuid::generate().to_string();
            let root = self.config.storage_root.join(&id);
            let mut session = NativeSession::spawn(&self.config.worker, &root).await?;
            session.load(content).await?;
            self.sessions.insert(id.clone(), session);
            Ok(id)
        }
    
        pub fn session(&mut self, id: &str) -> io::Result<&mut NativeSession> {
            self.sessions.get_mut(id).ok_or_else(|| {
                io::Error::new(
                    io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,
                    "session is not owned by this host",
                )
            })
        }
    
        pub async fn stop(&mut self, id: &str) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.require_control()?;
            let mut session = self
                .sessions
                .remove(id)
                .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::other("unknown session"))?;
            session.stop().await
        }
    
        pub async fn capture(&mut self, id: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<Artifact>> {
            if self.artifacts.len() + 2 > MAX_ARTIFACTS {
                return Err(io::Error::other(
                    "artifact quota reached; restart host to reset catalog",
                ));
            }
            let frames = self.session(id)?.capture().await?;
            let directory = self.config.storage_root.join("artifacts");
            fs::create_dir_all(&directory)?;
            let mut artifacts = Vec::new();
            for frame in frames {
                let id = SessionUuid::generate().to_string();
                let path = directory.join(format!("{id}.bgra"));
                fs::write(&path, &frame.bgra)?;
                let artifact = Artifact {
                    uri: format!("lotus://artifact/{id}"),
                    screen: frame.lease.screen,
                    width: frame.lease.width,
                    height: frame.lease.height,
                    bytes: frame.bgra.len(),
                    sha256: format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&frame.bgra)),
                };
                self.artifacts
                    .insert(artifact.uri.clone(), (artifact.clone(), path));
                artifacts.push(artifact);
            }
            Ok(artifacts)
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn artifacts(&self) -> Vec<Artifact> {
            self.artifacts
                .values()
                .map(|(artifact, _)| artifact.clone())
                .collect()
        }
    
        /// Resolve only catalogued immutable captures, never interpret a URI as a path.
        pub fn read_artifact(&self, uri: &str) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
            let (artifact, path) = self.artifacts.get(uri).ok_or_else(|| {
                io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied, "unknown artifact resource")
            })?;
            let data = fs::read(path)?;
            if data.len() != artifact.bytes || format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&data)) != artifact.sha256
            {
                return Err(io::Error::other("artifact identity mismatch"));
            }
            Ok(data)
        }
    }
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Verifies that every pinned dependency still points at the recorded revision.
    
    .DESCRIPTION
        Checks four things:
    
          1. The vendored Azahar checkout is at the pinned integration commit.
          2. The submodule pointer recorded in the index matches that commit.
          3. Cargo.lock resolves GPUI to the pinned upstream commit.
          4. The active Rust toolchain is the pinned channel.
    
        Exits with 1 when any check fails.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    if (Get-Variable -Name PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
    }
    Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Pins.psm1') -Force
    
    $root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
    $pinsPath = Join-Path $root 'config\pins.toml'
    
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pinsPath)) {
        Write-Error "missing $pinsPath"
        exit 1
    }
    
    $pins = Read-Pins -Path $pinsPath
    $failures = 0
    
    function Test-Pin {
        param(
            [string]$Name,
            [bool]$Ok,
            [string]$Detail
        )
    
        if ($Ok) {
            Write-Host ("PASS  {0}: {1}" -f $Name, $Detail) -ForegroundColor Green
        } else {
            Write-Host ("FAIL  {0}: {1}" -f $Name, $Detail) -ForegroundColor Red
            $script:failures++
        }
    }
    
    # 1. Vendored Azahar checkout.
    $azaharRoot = Join-Path $root $pins['azahar']['vendor_path']
    $expectedAzahar = $pins['azahar']['integration_commit']
    
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $azaharRoot '.git')) {
        $actualAzahar = (& git -C $azaharRoot rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
        Test-Pin -Name 'azahar checkout' -Ok ($actualAzahar -eq $expectedAzahar) `
            -Detail ("expected {0}, found {1}" -f $expectedAzahar, $actualAzahar)
    } else {
        Test-Pin -Name 'azahar checkout' -Ok $false -Detail "no checkout at $azaharRoot"
    }
    
    # 2. Submodule pointer in the index.
    $hasHead = $null -ne (& git -C $root rev-parse --verify HEAD 2>$null)
    if ($hasHead) {
        $pointer = (& git -C $root ls-tree HEAD $pins['azahar']['vendor_path'])
        if ($pointer -match '^160000 commit ([0-9a-f]{40})') {
            Test-Pin -Name 'azahar submodule pointer' -Ok ($Matches[1] -eq $expectedAzahar) `
                -Detail ("index records {0}" -f $Matches[1])
        } else {
            Test-Pin -Name 'azahar submodule pointer' -Ok $false -Detail 'no submodule pointer in the index'
        }
    } else {
        Test-Pin -Name 'azahar submodule pointer' -Ok $false -Detail 'the repository has no commit yet'
    }
    
    # 3. GPUI revision in Cargo.lock.
    $lockPath = Join-Path $root 'Cargo.lock'
    $expectedGpui = $pins['gpui']['rev']

        $lock = Get-Content -LiteralPath $lockPath -Raw
        $gpuiLocked = $lock -match [regex]::Escape("rev=$expectedGpui")
        Test-Pin -Name 'gpui lock entry' -Ok $gpuiLocked `
            -Detail ("expected rev {0} in Cargo.lock" -f $expectedGpui)
    } else {
        Test-Pin -Name 'gpui lock entry' -Ok $false -Detail 'Cargo.lock is missing'
    }
    
    # 4. Rust toolchain.
    $expectedRust = $pins['rust']['channel']
    $rustcVersion = (& rustc --version)
    Test-Pin -Name 'rust toolchain' -Ok ($rustcVersion -like "*$expectedRust*") `
        -Detail ("expected {0}, found {1}" -f $expectedRust, $rustcVersion.Trim())
    
    if ($failures -gt 0) {
        Write-Host ''
        Write-Host "$failures pin check(s) failed." -ForegroundColor Red
        exit 1
    }
    
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'All pins verified.' -ForegroundColor Green
    exit 0

    //! Bounded execution of the implemented homebrew/software scenario subset.
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::fs::{self, File};
    use std::io::{self, Read};
    use std::path::Path;
    use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
    
    use lotus_protocol::envelope::SessionUuid;
    use lotus_session::native_session::{InputState, NativeSession};
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use serde_json::Value;
    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
    
    use crate::{InputEvent, Scenario};
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct Checkpoint {
        pub frame: u64,
        pub screen: String,
        pub sha256: String,
        pub bytes: usize,
        pub artifact: String,
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct RunReport {
        pub name: String,
        pub backend: String,
        pub content_sha256: String,
        pub worker_executable_sha256: String,
        pub source: String,
        pub frames: u64,
        pub checkpoints: Vec<Checkpoint>,
        pub final_status: Value,
        pub host_elapsed_ms: u128,
        pub evidence: String,
    }
    
    /// SHA-256 without loading an entire executable/content asset into memory.
    pub fn file_hash(path: &Path) -> io::Result<String> {
        let mut input = File::open(path)?;
        let mut hash = Sha256::new();
        let mut buffer = [0; 65536];
        loop {
            let count = input.read(&mut buffer)?;
            if count == 0 {
                break;
            }
            hash.update(&buffer[..count]);
        }
        Ok(format!("{:x}", hash.finalize()))
    }
    
    fn invalid(message: impl Into<String>) -> io::Error {
        io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, message.into())
    }
    
    /// Reject unsupported promises before creating a worker or an artifact directory.
    pub fn validate_execution(scenario: &Scenario) -> io::Result<()> {
        scenario
            .validate()
            .map_err(|error| invalid(error.to_string()))?;
        if scenario.content.kind != "homebrew_3dsx"
            || scenario.profile.model != "old3ds"
            || scenario.profile.renderer != "software"
            || scenario.profile.audio_output != "discard"
            || scenario.profile.deterministic_initial_ticks.unwrap_or(0) != 0
            || scenario.storage.mode != "isolated_copy"
            || scenario.storage.base_snapshot.is_some()
            || scenario.input.owner != "scenario"
        {
            return Err(invalid("executor requires homebrew_3dsx, old3ds/software, discard, ticks 0, empty isolated_copy, scenario input"));
        }
        if scenario.input.schedule.len() > 4096 || scenario.captures.len() > 64 {
            return Err(invalid("scenario event/capture count limit"));
        }
        for event in &scenario.input.schedule {
            validate_event(event)?;
        }
        for capture in &scenario.captures {
            let frame = capture
                .when
                .as_ref()
                .and_then(|when| when.frame)
                .ok_or_else(|| invalid("only frame capture triggers are supported"))?;
            if frame == 0
                || frame > scenario.stop.max_frames
                || capture
                    .when
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_some_and(|when| when.event.is_some())
                || capture
                    .include
                    .iter()
                    .any(|item| item != "top_raw_frame" && item != "bottom_raw_frame")
                || capture.max_bytes.is_some_and(|bytes| bytes < 691200)
            {
                return Err(invalid(
                    "capture requires bounded native top/bottom screens",
                ));
            }
        }
        if scenario
            .assertions
            .iter()
            .any(|assertion| !matches!(assertion.kind.as_str(), "no_worker_crash" | "frame_count"))
        {
            return Err(invalid("event assertions require the future trace backend"));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    fn button_mask(button: &str) -> Option<u32> {
        let index = match button.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
            "a" => 0,
            "b" => 1,
            "x" => 2,
            "y" => 3,
            "up" => 4,
            "down" => 5,
            "left" => 6,
            "right" => 7,
            "l" => 8,
            "r" => 9,
            "start" => 10,
            "select" => 11,
            "zl" => 14,
            "zr" => 15,
            _ => return None,
        };
        Some(1 << index)
    }
    
    fn validate_event(event: &InputEvent) -> io::Result<()> {
        if !matches!(event.action.as_str(), "down" | "up" | "press") {
            return Err(invalid("unknown input action"));
        }
        if event.button == "touch" {
            if event.x.is_none_or(|x| x >= 320) || event.y.is_none_or(|y| y >= 240) {
                return Err(invalid("touch requires native x/y coordinates"));
            }
        } else if button_mask(&event.button).is_none() {
            return Err(invalid("unknown button"));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    
    fn apply_input(state: &mut InputState, event: &InputEvent) {
        let pressed = event.action != "up";
        if event.button == "touch" {
            state.x = event.x.expect("validated touch x");
            state.y = event.y.expect("validated touch y");
            state.touch = pressed;
        } else {
            let mask = button_mask(&event.button).expect("validated button");
            if pressed {
                state.buttons |= mask;
            } else {
                state.buttons &= !mask;
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// One fresh root, one worker, one bounded run. Always attempt stop; Drop kills on failure.
    pub async fn run(
        scenario: &Scenario,
        scenario_directory: &Path,
        executable: &Path,
        output: &Path,
    ) -> io::Result<RunReport> {
        validate_execution(scenario)?;
        let content = scenario_directory
            .join(&scenario.content.path_handle)
            .canonicalize()?;
        let content_hash = file_hash(&content)?;
        if scenario
            .content
            .sha256
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|expected| expected.to_ascii_lowercase() != content_hash)
        {
            return Err(invalid("fixture SHA-256 mismatch"));
        }
        let executable_hash = file_hash(executable)?;
        // create_dir rejects accidental overwrite/reuse of a prior run.
        fs::create_dir_all(output.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new(".")))?;
        fs::create_dir(output)?;
        let started = Instant::now();
        let mut session = NativeSession::spawn(executable, &output.join("worker")).await?;
        let result = tokio::time::timeout(
            Duration::from_secs(scenario.stop.wall_timeout_seconds),
            async {
                session.load(&content).await?;
                session.input(InputState::default(), "scenario").await?;
                let mut schedule: BTreeMap<u64, Vec<InputEvent>> = BTreeMap::new();
                for event in &scenario.input.schedule {
                    schedule
                        .entry(event.at_frame)
                        .or_default()
                        .push(event.clone());
                    if event.action == "press" && event.at_frame < scenario.stop.max_frames {
                        let mut release = event.clone();
                        release.action = "up".into();
                        release.at_frame += 1;
                        schedule.entry(release.at_frame).or_default().push(release);
                    }
                }
                let mut checkpoints = Vec::new();
                let mut frame = 0;
                let mut input = InputState::default();
                loop {
                    if let Some(events) = schedule.get(&frame) {
                        for event in events {
                            apply_input(&mut input, event);
                        }
                        session.input(input, "scenario").await?;
                    }
                    if frame > 0
                        && (frame == scenario.stop.max_frames
                            || scenario.captures.iter().any(|capture| {
                                capture.when.as_ref().and_then(|when| when.frame) == Some(frame)
                            }))
                    {
                        for captured in session.capture().await? {
                            let filename = format!("{frame}-{}.bgra", captured.lease.screen);
                            let hash = format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&captured.bgra));
                            fs::write(output.join(&filename), &captured.bgra)?;
                            checkpoints.push(Checkpoint {
                                frame,
                                screen: captured.lease.screen,
                                sha256: hash,
                                bytes: captured.bgra.len(),
                                artifact: filename,
                            });
                        }
                    }
                    if frame == scenario.stop.max_frames {
                        break;
                    }
                    let next_input = schedule
                        .range((frame + 1)..)
                        .next()
                        .map(|(key, _)| *key)
                        .unwrap_or(scenario.stop.max_frames);
                    let next_capture = scenario
                        .captures
                        .iter()
                        .filter_map(|capture| capture.when.as_ref().and_then(|when| when.frame))
                        .filter(|next| *next > frame)
                        .min()
                        .unwrap_or(scenario.stop.max_frames);
                    let next = (frame + 60)
                        .min(next_input)
                        .min(next_capture)
                        .min(scenario.stop.max_frames);
                    let status = session.advance((next - frame) as u16).await?;
                    if status["frames"].as_u64() != Some(next) {
                        return Err(io::Error::other("worker missed exact frame checkpoint"));
                    }
                    frame = next;
                }
                for assertion in &scenario.assertions {
                    if assertion.kind == "frame_count"
                        && assertion.minimum.is_some_and(|minimum| frame < minimum)
                    {
                        return Err(io::Error::other("frame count assertion failed"));
                    }
                }
                let status = session.status().await?;
                Ok(RunReport {
                    name: scenario.name.clone(),
                    backend: status["backend_name"].as_str().unwrap_or("unknown").into(),
                    content_sha256: content_hash,
                    worker_executable_sha256: executable_hash,
                    source: status["source"].as_str().unwrap_or("unknown").into(),
                    frames: frame,
                    checkpoints,
                    final_status: status,
                    host_elapsed_ms: started.elapsed().as_millis(),
                    evidence: "verified emulator; no hardware claim".into(),
                })
            },
        )
        .await;
        let result = match result {
            Ok(result) => result,
            Err(_) => Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
                "scenario host deadline",
            )),
        };
        let stop = session.stop().await;
        match result {
            Ok(report) => {
                stop?;
                fs::write(
                    output.join("report.json"),
                    serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&report).map_err(io::Error::other)?,
                )?;
                Ok(report)
            }
            Err(error) => {
                fs::write(
                    output.join("failure.json"),
                    serde_json::json!({"error": error.to_string()}).to_string(),
                )?;
                Err(error)
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// Repeat with fresh storage; compare guest pixel hashes, excluding host telemetry.
    pub async fn repeat(
        scenario: &Scenario,
        directory: &Path,
        executable: &Path,
        root: &Path,
        count: u8,
    ) -> io::Result<Vec<RunReport>> {
        if !(1..=10).contains(&count) {
            return Err(invalid("repeat count must be 1..=10"));
        }
        let mut reports: Vec<RunReport> = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..count {
            let output = root.join(SessionUuid::generate().to_string());
            let report = run(scenario, directory, executable, &output).await?;
            if let Some(first) = reports.first() {
                if first
                    .checkpoints
                    .iter()
                    .map(|point| (&point.screen, point.frame, &point.sha256))
                    .ne(report
                        .checkpoints
                        .iter()
                        .map(|point| (&point.screen, point.frame, &point.sha256)))
                {
                    return Err(io::Error::other(
                        "repeated guest frame hashes diverged; inspect retained reports",
                    ));
                }
            }
            reports.push(report);
        }
        Ok(reports)
    }
