    # Native sessions, frames and containment
    
    LOTUS is the application. The upstream-tracking `integration` branch supplies
    the **AZAHAR** backend. The `experimental` branch supplies **CITnLO**, based on
    integration. The eventual replacement backend is **LOTUS**. These names do not
    change the existing wire protocol or executable names.
    
    The native frontend uses software rendering, Old 3DS, fixed initial ticks 0,
    fixed time 2000-01-01 UTC, HLE services/DSP and a muted audio sink. It never opens
    Qt/SDL windows. Unsupported keyboard/Mii callbacks pause with an explicit
    `unsupported_applet` reason. This does not implement arbitrary firmware applets.
    
    ## Implemented protocol
    
    The length-prefixed private pipe transport from document 18 now accepts `params`
    and returns `data`. Version remains 1.0; these are additive fields. The native
    backend identifier is `azahar_native_software`. Only one mutable Rust owner sends
    commands. IDs increase and are never retried after a transport failure.
    
    | Method | Parameters | Completion |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | hello/status | none | state, source SHA, presented frames, input/audio statistics |
    | load | path, local `.3dsx` | loaded and paused, epoch incremented, or typed error |
    | run | frames 1–600 | started; automatically pauses at budget or 20 host seconds |
    | run_until | frames 1–600 | paused after advancing, or explicit error/deadline |
    | pause | none | outer RunLoop returned; no nested teardown |
    | reset | none | same content reloaded, paused, epoch incremented |
    | capture | none | two native screen leases copied from latest software output |
    | input | owner live/scenario, buttons, x/y, touch | complete input state installed |
    | registers | core 0–3, also checked against active core count | 16 registers/CPSR at safe point |
    | read_memory | address u32, length 1–4096 | mapped current-process bytes at safe point |
    | stop | none | core shut down, then process exit required by supervisor |
    
    Queue capacity is 16 messages of at most 64 KiB. Only the reader thread touches
    the queue; all emulated state stays on the emulation thread. The existing
    `NotifyPendingWork` event wakes the frame limiter. The optional frontend callback
    in `ProcessPendingWork` services status/register/memory inspection there.
    Load/reset/stop and capture run outside nested RunLoop calls. No selected-core
    single-step precision is claimed.
    
    ## Ownership and budgets
    
    Frames use three reusable file slots per screen under the private root. Each
    has a 32-byte little-endian header: `LTRF`, version u32, epoch u64, sequence u64,
    width u32, height u32; then native BGRA8 pixels in top-left row order. Metadata
    also includes byte length, stride, slot and orientation. Rust validates all
    fields, bounds allocation, checks the header and returns owned pixels before
    another capture. There is no wait for UI acknowledgement. Old slot sequences,
    reset epochs and stopped/crashed sessions invalidate leases. Total pixel slot
    storage is bounded to 2,073,600 bytes plus six headers.
    
    Input factories expose one complete state to HID. Scenario ownership excludes
    live input until reload/reset. Sending all-zero state releases keys/touch after
    device disconnect. This version has no host audio device: the DSP submits to a
    16,384-stereo-sample muted ring, drops oldest samples on overflow, and reports
    sample/drop counts and FNV-1a checksum. Status drains the ring. The checksum is
    an emulator diagnostic, not an audio quality/hardware claim.
    
    On Windows, the supervisor starts the child suspended, assigns a kill-on-close
    job, then resumes its initial thread. Descendants inherit containment. Each
    root has an OS file lock held through process lifetime. Crashes retain stderr
    and native logs, invalidate leases, terminate the job and release the lock.
    Non-Windows builds currently retain direct-child termination only; descendant
    containment there is unimplemented and untested.
    
    ## Reproducible checks

    descendant termination and same-root exclusion. Native tests are opt-in, never
    silently counted as passing without assets:

    $env:LOTUS_NATIVE_WORKER = (Resolve-Path build/azahar-integration-native/bin/Release/ctr-worker.exe).Path

    cargo test -p lotus-session --test native_process -- --ignored --nocapture

    # Local MCP adapter
    
    `lotus-mcp [host-config.json]` serves stdio only. Without configuration it can
    report status but cannot spawn workers or read files. Host configuration fixes
    the executable, root, approved asset handles and control permission:
    
    ```json
    {
      "worker": "C:/path/to/ctr-worker.exe",
      "storage_root": "C:/path/to/private-runs",
      "assets": {"demo": "C:/path/to/demo.3dsx"},
      "allow_control": true
    }
    ```
    
    Configuration is trusted local startup input, never a tool parameter. Each
    server process owns its sessions and artifact catalog. Client tools cannot
    select executables, roots or arbitrary content paths. Controls require
    `allow_control`; status/memory/capture operate only on owned sessions.
    Four workers and 128 screen artifacts (at most 49,152,000 bytes) bound resources.

    /// A file-ring lease. Reading checks identity before exposing owned pixel bytes.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
    pub struct FrameLease {
        pub screen: String,
        pub path: String,
        pub epoch: u64,
        pub sequence: u64,
        pub slot: u64,
        pub width: u32,
        pub height: u32,
        pub stride: u32,
        pub format: String,
        pub orientation: String,
        pub bytes: usize,
    }
    
    /// Native pixels copied out of a ring slot; independent of subsequent captures.
    #[derive(Debug)]
    pub struct Frame {
        pub lease: FrameLease,
        pub bgra: Vec<u8>,
    }
    
    /// Input is a complete state, so disconnect/release can always send zero.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct InputState {
        pub buttons: u32,
        pub x: u16,
        pub y: u16,
        pub touch: bool,
    }
    
    /// Owns one private native worker. Each command completes at an emulation safe point.
    #[derive(Debug)]
    pub struct NativeSession {
        worker: ControlledWorker,
        root: PathBuf,
    }
    
    impl NativeSession {
        pub async fn spawn(executable: &Path, root: &Path) -> io::Result<Self> {
            fs::create_dir_all(root)?;
            let root = native_path(root)?;
            let mut worker =
                ControlledWorker::spawn(&WorkerSpec::new(executable, &root), Duration::from_secs(30))
                    .await?;
            let reply = worker.status().await?;
            if reply.backend != "azahar_native_software" {
                worker.stop().await?;
                return Err(io::Error::other("worker lacks native software capability"));
            }
            fs::write(
                root.join("native-manifest.json"),
                serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&serde_json::json!({
                    "protocol": lotus_protocol::protocol_id(), "backend": reply.backend,
                    "source": reply.data["source"], "backend_name": reply.data["backend_name"],
                    "session": reply.session, "pid": worker.pid(), "epoch": reply.epoch,
                    "profile": "old3ds/software/hle/dsp-muted/ticks-0/time-2000-01-01",
                }))
                .map_err(io::Error::other)?,
            )?;
            Ok(Self { worker, root })
        }
    
        pub async fn load(&mut self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Value> {
            self.operation(
                Method::Load,
                serde_json::json!({"path": native_path(path)?}),
            )
            .await
        }
    
        /// Advance 1–600 presented frames, with a native 20s and supervisor 30s deadline.
        pub async fn advance(&mut self, frames: u16) -> io::Result<Value> {
            if frames == 0 || frames > 600 {
                return Err(io::Error::other("frame batch must be in 1..=600"));
            }
            self.operation(Method::RunUntil, serde_json::json!({"frames": frames}))
                .await
        }
    
        pub async fn run(&mut self) -> io::Result<Value> {
            self.operation(Method::Run, serde_json::json!({"frames": 600}))
                .await
        }
    
        pub async fn pause(&mut self) -> io::Result<Value> {
            self.operation(Method::Pause, Value::Null).await
        }
    
        pub async fn reset(&mut self) -> io::Result<Value> {
            self.operation(Method::Reset, Value::Null).await
        }
    
        pub async fn input(&mut self, state: InputState, owner: &str) -> io::Result<Value> {
            let mut params = serde_json::to_value(state).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            params["owner"] = owner.into();
            self.operation(Method::Input, params).await
        }
    
        pub async fn status(&mut self) -> io::Result<Value> {
            self.operation(Method::Status, Value::Null).await
        }
    
        pub async fn registers(&mut self, core: u32) -> io::Result<Value> {
            self.operation(Method::Registers, serde_json::json!({"core": core}))
                .await
        }
    
        pub async fn memory(&mut self, address: u32, length: u16) -> io::Result<Value> {
            self.operation(
                Method::ReadMemory,
                serde_json::json!({"address": address, "length": length}),
            )
            .await
        }
    
        pub async fn capture(&mut self) -> io::Result<Vec<Frame>> {
            let data = self.operation(Method::Capture, Value::Null).await?;
            let leases: Vec<FrameLease> =
                serde_json::from_value(data["frames"].clone()).map_err(io::Error::other)?;
            if leases.len() != 2 {
                return Err(io::Error::other(
                    "capture must contain exactly two native screens",
                ));
            }
            leases
                .into_iter()
                .map(|lease| {
                    let bgra = self.read_lease(&lease)?;
                    Ok(Frame { lease, bgra })
                })
                .collect()
        }
    
        pub async fn stop(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {
            self.worker.stop().await
        }
    
        /// Explicit failure injection and emergency termination, limited to this job.
        pub async fn abort(&mut self) {
            self.worker.abort().await;
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn root(&self) -> &Path {
            &self.root
        }
    
        #[must_use]
        pub fn state(&self) -> SessionState {
            self.worker.state()
        }
    
        pub fn read_lease(&self, lease: &FrameLease) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
            if !matches!(
                self.worker.state(),
                SessionState::Paused | SessionState::Running
            ) || self.worker.epoch() != lease.epoch
            {
                return Err(io::Error::other("frame lease invalidated by lifecycle"));
            }
            read_frame(&self.root, lease)
        }
    
        async fn operation(&mut self, method: Method, params: Value) -> io::Result<Value> {
            let Reply { status, data, .. } = self.worker.command(method, params).await?;
            if status != Status::Ok {
                return Err(io::Error::other(format!("{method:?}: {status:?}: {data}")));
            }
            Ok(data)
        }
    }

    Add: C:\Users\julie\workdir\3DS\lotus\tests\compare_stock_native.py
    """Compare stock oracle RGBA with a stopped native --boot frame ring (slot 0)."""
    import hashlib
    from pathlib import Path
    import struct
    import sys
    
    
    def exact_read(path, size):
        with path.open("rb") as source:
            data = source.read(size + 1)
        assert len(data) == size, f"unexpected byte count: {path}"
        return data
    
    
    def main():
        stock, native = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
        for screen, width in (("top", 400), ("bottom", 320)):
            size = width * 240 * 4
            expected = exact_read(stock / f"{screen}.rgba", size)
            slot = exact_read(native / "frames" / f"{screen}-0.bgra", size + 32)
            magic, version, epoch, sequence, actual_width, height = struct.unpack(
                "<4sIQQII", slot[:32]
            )
            assert (magic, version, actual_width, height) == (b"LTRF", 1, width, 240)
            assert epoch > 0 and sequence > 0
            rgba = bytearray(slot[32:])
            rgba[0::4], rgba[2::4] = rgba[2::4], rgba[0::4]
            assert rgba == expected, f"{screen}: native pixels differ from stock"
            print(f"{screen}: identical RGBA SHA-256 {hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest()}")
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()

    # Build and dependency pins
    
    LOTUS uses native process workers: **AZAHAR** (`integration`) and **CITnLO**
    (`experimental`). The future replacement backend is **LOTUS**. The two Azahar
    branches currently share integration code; no accuracy experiments exist yet.
    
    Immutable revisions live in [config/pins.toml](../config/pins.toml); Cargo.lock
    pins Rust dependencies and vendor/azahar pins native source. Upstream control:
    `11eceda5e0e682a1f44e396bf954a1b9137097ca`. GPUI/Zed:
    `6b720973027999bae402df23d469026f4cced988`. Rust:
    `1.98.1-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu`.
    
    ## Build
    
    This Windows host uses GCC/MinGW-w64 16.2, CMake 4.4.3 and Ninja. MSVC and other
    host platforms are untested. GPUI links against Windows D3D import libraries.
    Its existing `.rsrc merge failure: multiple non-default manifests` warning remains
    visible; visual acceptance is deferred at the user's request.
    
    ```powershell
    scripts/bootstrap.ps1
    scripts/smoke.ps1
    scripts/build-azahar.ps1 -Branch integration
    scripts/build-azahar.ps1 -Branch experimental
    scripts/build-azahar.ps1 -Branch stock -Oracle -BuildDirectory build/azahar-stock
    ```
    
    Native builds require sibling worktrees `azahar-stock`, `azahar-integration`,
    `azahar-experimental`, or an explicit `-AzaharRoot`. Each must be clean at its
    manifest pin, with recursive submodules initialized. Existing worktrees were
    created from the supplied parent azahar clone; see [20](20-native-baseline.md).
    The script rejects moving/dirty inputs and a cache belonging to another tree.
    Each flavor has its own cache and `lotus-build-manifest.json` with SHA/flags/host.
    It builds native `ctr-worker` directly. `workers/azahar` is a retired scaffold
    stub and is not the runtime target. Local native commits must be published or
    transferred with their Git objects before a different machine can fetch the pins.
    
    The initial native matrix is Release, software renderer, Qt/SDL/Libretro off,
    host audio devices off, GDB compiled but disabled, LTO off. See script for every
    flag. There are no runtime dependency downloads and no bundled Nintendo assets.
    
    ## Run
    
    Create an ignored local host configuration as shown in [23](23-local-mcp.md).
    The desktop and MCP consume the same configuration and native session API:
    
    ```powershell
    cargo run -p lotus-desktop --bin lotus-desktop -- build/local-host.json
    cargo run -p lotus-mcp --bin lotus-mcp -- build/local-host.json
    cargo run -p lotus-cli --bin ctr-cli -- scenario run specs/native-smoke.yaml build/azahar-integration-native/bin/Release/ctr-worker.exe build/runs 3
    ```
    
    Both applications default to an empty host without configuration. Explicit
    approved asset handles avoid arbitrary-path MCP access. The desktop can create
    four sessions, select/dock screens, run/pause/reset/stop and route keyboard/touch.
    No real audio device is opened; the native DSP sink drains a bounded muted ring.

    """Native pipe contract without guest assets: python tests/test_native_protocol.py <worker>."""
    import json
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import queue
    import struct
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import tempfile
    import threading
    
    
    class Worker:
        def __init__(self, executable):
            self.root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="lotus-wire-"))
            self.log = (self.root / "test.stderr.log").open("wb")
            self.process = subprocess.Popen([executable], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                            stderr=self.log, env={**os.environ, "LOTUS_STORAGE_ROOT": str(self.root)},
                                            creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if sys.platform == "win32" else 0)
            self.messages = queue.Queue()
            def read():
                try:
                    while prefix := self.process.stdout.read(4):
                        assert len(prefix) == 4
                        length, = struct.unpack("<I", prefix)
                        assert 0 < length <= 65536
                        payload = self.process.stdout.read(length)
                        assert len(payload) == length
                        self.messages.put(json.loads(payload))
                finally:
                    self.messages.put(None)
            threading.Thread(target=read, daemon=True).start()
    
        def request(self, identity=1, **overrides):
            request = dict(version_major=1, version_minor=0, request_id=identity,
                           session="0" * 32, epoch=1, method="hello", params=None)
            request.update(overrides)
            payload = json.dumps(request).encode()
            self.process.stdin.write(struct.pack("<I", len(payload)) + payload)
            self.process.stdin.flush()
            return self.messages.get(timeout=5)
    
        def close(self):
            if self.process.poll() is None:
                self.process.kill()
            self.process.wait(timeout=5)
            self.log.close()
    
    
    def main():
        executable = str(Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve())
        worker = Worker(executable)
        try:
            assert worker.request()["status"] == "ok"
            assert worker.request(2, method="status", epoch=0)["status"] == "stale_epoch"
            assert worker.request(3, method="status", session="f" * 32)["status"] == "permission_denied"
            assert worker.request(4, version_major=2)["status"] == "unsupported"
            assert worker.request(5, method="load", params={"path": "missing.3dsx"})["status"] == "invalid_argument"
            assert worker.request(6, method="status")["status"] == "ok"
            assert worker.request(7, method="stop")["state"] == "stopped"
            worker.process.wait(timeout=5)
            assert worker.process.returncode == 0
        finally:
            worker.close()
        for invalid in (b"\0\0\0\0", struct.pack("<I", 65537), struct.pack("<I", 2) + b"{"):
            worker = Worker(executable)
            try:
                worker.process.stdin.write(invalid)
                worker.process.stdin.close()
                assert worker.messages.get(timeout=5) is None
                worker.process.wait(timeout=5)
            finally:
                worker.close()
        for changes in ({"unexpected": 1}, {"request_id": 1}):
            worker = Worker(executable)
            try:
                assert worker.request()["status"] == "ok"
                assert worker.request(2, method="status", **changes) is None
                worker.process.wait(timeout=5)
                assert worker.process.returncode != 0
            finally:
                worker.close()
        print("Native framing/identity/epoch/version/length/truncation/replay: passed")
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Regenerates SHA256SUMS.txt for the dossier files.
    
    .DESCRIPTION
        The manifest covers the human readable dossier: the readme, the agent
        rules, the documents, the proposed specs and the templates. It does not
        cover source code: git already tracks those byte for byte.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param()
    
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    $root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
    
    $targets = @('AGENTS.md', 'README.md')
    $targets += Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'docs') -Filter '*.md' -File |
        ForEach-Object { 'docs/' + $_.Name }
    $targets += Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'specs') -File -Recurse |
        ForEach-Object { 'specs/' + $_.Name }
    $targets += Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'templates') -File -Recurse |
        ForEach-Object { 'templates/' + $_.Name }
    
    $lines = foreach ($target in $targets) {
        $path = Join-Path $root ($target -replace '/', '\')
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) {
            $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
            "$hash  $target"
        }
    }
    
    $manifest = Join-Path $root 'SHA256SUMS.txt'
    $lines | Set-Content -LiteralPath $manifest -Encoding utf8
    
    Write-Host "wrote $($lines.Count) entries to $manifest" -ForegroundColor Green

    //! Lotus MCP server binary.
    //!
    //! The server speaks MCP over stdio. It is local only: no TCP listener is
    //! opened and no remote client can attach.
    
    use lotus_mcp::LotusServer;
    use lotus_session::supervisor::HostConfig;
    use rmcp::ServiceExt;
    
    #[tokio::main]
    async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
        let server = if let Some(path) = std::env::args_os().nth(1) {
            let config: HostConfig = serde_json::from_str(&std::fs::read_to_string(path)?)?;
            LotusServer::configured(config, std::collections::BTreeMap::new())?
        } else {
            LotusServer::new()
        };
        let service = server.serve(rmcp::transport::stdio()).await?;
        service.waiting().await?;
        Ok(())
    }
    //! `ctr-cli`: headless access to the Lotus tooling.
    //!
    //! The CLI shares the same typed operations as the desktop application and
    //! the MCP server. It never opens a window and never requires a GUI session.
    
    use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
    use lotus_protocol::protocol_id;
    use lotus_runner::Scenario;
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use std::path::PathBuf;
    
    /// Pinned revisions, mirrored from `config/pins.toml`.
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    struct Pins {
        azahar: AzaharPins,
        gpui: GpuiPins,
        rust: RustPins,
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    struct AzaharPins {
        repository: String,
        fork: String,
        upstream_commit: String,
        integration_branch: String,
        integration_commit: String,
        experimental_branch: String,
        experimental_commit: String,
        vendor_path: String,
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    struct GpuiPins {
        repository: String,
        rev: String,
        crate_version: String,
    }
    
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    struct RustPins {
        channel: String,
        host: String,
    }
    
    /// Usage text.
    const USAGE: &str = "\
    ctr-cli: Lotus command line interface
    
    Usage:
      ctr-cli version              Print the Lotus version and worker protocol version
      ctr-cli mock <worker-executable> Query a mock worker over private pipes
      ctr-cli pins                 Print the pinned Azahar and GPUI revisions
      ctr-cli scenario validate <path>
                                    Validate a scenario file against the execution limits
      ctr-cli scenario run <path> <worker> <artifact-root> [repeat-count]
                                    Execute bounded native runs (default: 3)
    ";
    
    fn main() -> Result<()> {
        let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
        let command = args.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("help");
    
        match command {
            "version" => {
                println!("lotus {}", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
                println!("worker protocol {}", protocol_id());

            "pins" => {
                let pins = load_pins()?;
                println!("{}", toml::to_string_pretty(&pins)?);
            }
            "mock" => {
                let executable = args
                    .get(1)
                    .context("usage: ctr-cli mock <worker-executable>")?;
                let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
                    "lotus-cli-{}",
                    lotus_protocol::envelope::SessionUuid::generate()
                ));
                let spec = lotus_session::WorkerSpec::new(executable, &root);
                let runtime = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new()?;
                runtime.block_on(async {
                    let mut worker = lotus_session::controlled_worker::ControlledWorker::spawn(
                        &spec,
                        std::time::Duration::from_secs(3),
                    )
                    .await?;
                    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string(&worker.status().await?)?);
                    worker.stop().await
                })?;
            }
            "scenario" => {
                let sub = args.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("help");

                    "run" => {
                        let path = PathBuf::from(
                            args.get(2)
                                .context("scenario run requires path, worker and artifact root")?,
                        );
                        let worker = PathBuf::from(args.get(3).context("missing worker executable")?)
                            .canonicalize()?;
                        let output = PathBuf::from(args.get(4).context("missing artifact root")?);

                            .get(5)

                            .unwrap_or(3);
                        let scenario = Scenario::load(&path)?;
                        let directory = path.parent().unwrap_or(std::path::Path::new("."));
                        let reports = tokio::runtime::Runtime::new()?.block_on(
                            lotus_runner::execution::repeat(
                                &scenario, directory, &worker, &output, count,
                            ),
                        )?;
                        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&reports)?);
                    }
                    "validate" => {
                        let path = args
                            .get(2)
                            .context("usage: ctr-cli scenario validate <path>")?;
                        let scenario = Scenario::load(path)
                            .with_context(|| format!("cannot load scenario {path}"))?;
                        scenario
                            .validate()
                            .with_context(|| format!("scenario {path} is invalid"))?;
                        println!("scenario {} is valid", scenario.name);
                    }
                    _ => {
                        println!("{USAGE}");
                        bail!("unknown scenario subcommand: {sub}");

    # Implementer rules — read before touching code
    
    ## Order of authority
    
    1. Measured physical-hardware behavior > independent hardware trace > documented specification > existing emulator behavior > hypothesis.
    2. User's explicit decisions: native Azahar integration (**not Libretro**), Rust + GPUI, multiple isolated workers, two Azahar branches (`integration`, `experimental`).
    3. Preserve compatibility and successful baselines before speculative accuracy changes.
    
    ## Attribution
    
    Agents never insert their own branding as a commit attribution or co-attribution. All commits are authored solely by the git identity already set on the authors computer. For example, the project owner's git identity should always be `terezi <jules@foxtails.me>`.
    
    ## Documentation
    
    Agents should keep documentation and comments as brief as possible. This does not mean spare on technical details. Explain what it is, what it's doing, how it works, what it isn't, and the relevant necessary information.
    
    Agents must keep documentation consistent.
    
    Agents must always be able to refer back to primary sources (such as 3DBrew, the citra wiki, source code citations from azahar) to justify changes or decisions. Agents are encouraged to use secondary sources, such as Coffeepot, for easy lookup of information - coffeepot, however, should not be your citation.
    
    ## Branch discipline
    
    - `integration`: only smallest viable native worker/front-end hooks, configurable build target, deterministic control queue, frame/audio/input adapters, and proven bug fixes required for integration. No GPU timing redesign or pervasive tracing. Regular upstream merges.
    - `experimental`: based on `integration`; structured tracing, debugger controls, snapshot experiments, timing models, hardware-fidelity experiments. Never merge `experimental` wholesale into `integration`.
    - Any item that seems essential to integration but introduces accuracy behavior changes needs an ADR and separate two-step PR.
    - Freeze upstream baseline SHA and CMake options in each test report. One independent worktree/build directory per branch. Never build both using one configured CMake cache.
    
    ## Evidence and debugging
    
    - Never confuse host milliseconds, virtual 3DS ticks, and empirically inferred hardware cycles.
    - Never claim a new accuracy feature without a hardware witness, an independent reference, and a counterexample where the old behavior differed.
    - Any cross-thread mutable emulated-state read MUST run at a defined safe point or return a labeled approximate telemetry snapshot.
    - Instrument with bounded buffers, severity filters and loss counters. Avoid `printf` in hot paths. Measure instrumentation-on/off overhead.
    - A GPU draw capture must describe the actual command/state at the draw, not a post-frame memory reconstruction. Pre-draw hashes must be computed by the draw or use frozen memory snapshots; never hash unrelated time-dependent registers as image identity.
    - Label examples explicitly: **verified compiled**, **verified hardware**, **verified emulator**, **source inspected**, or **proposed**. No unverifiable green check marks.
    
    ## Implementation quality
    
    - Prefer a narrow PR with a runnable acceptance test over a broad refactor.
    - Keep the C++ worker free of GPUI, MCP, and agent concepts.
    - Keep FFI structs plain, fixed-width and versioned; do not expose `std::string`, `std::vector`, `Core::System*` or internal layouts across IPC.
    - No unsandboxed remote RPC listener by default. MCP/control access local-only and scoped to explicitly created workers.
    - Treat ROMs, firmware, save data, logs and captures as sensitive user assets. Do not upload them, bundle them, or include them in bug reports without consent.
    - On worker crash, retain logs and metadata, invalidate frame-buffer leases, terminate child descendants and release per-instance locks.
    - Do not implement experimental multi-instance support by embedding two Azahar `Core::System`s in one process: globals and lifetime assumptions are not cleared.
    - Avoid speculative architectural abstractions that lack a second backend or a concrete test.
    
    ## Definition of done for every PR
    
    1. Explain touched subsystem, expected change, and branch rationale.
    2. Enumerate upstream source revision and build flags; tests and known untested platforms.
    3. Include a test that would fail without the change (or justify an instrumentation-only PR).
    4. Record guest output hash/checkpoints and host overhead for performance-relevant changes.
    5. Confirm clean shutdown, second launch, and two parallel workers if shared process/storage infrastructure changed.
    6. Update docs/source-map and protocol schema for altered interfaces.
    7. Make limitations explicit; retain rollback flag for risk-bearing work.

        path = vendor/azahar

        branch = integration
    # Pinned dependency revisions for Lotus.
    #
    # Every external source this project builds against is pinned to an exact
    # commit. Moving a pin is a deliberate act: update the file, update
    # Cargo.lock or the submodule pointer in the same commit, and record why.
    #
    # Verified by scripts/verify-pins.ps1.
    
    [azahar]
    # Upstream project.
    repository = "https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar.git"
    # Single fork that carries the two long lived branches.
    fork = "https://github.com/estyseesghosts/azahar.git"
    # Upstream commit the fork is based on.
    upstream_commit = "11eceda5e0e682a1f44e396bf954a1b9137097ca"
    # Branch with upstream minimal native worker hooks.
    integration_branch = "integration"
    integration_commit = "05773bbb5380bc5094fcd8eacf189fdc5d6360bb"
    # Branch with tracing, debugger and accuracy experiments.
    experimental_branch = "experimental"
    experimental_commit = "05773bbb5380bc5094fcd8eacf189fdc5d6360bb"
    # Vendored checkout of the pinned Azahar source.
    vendor_path = "vendor/azahar"
    
    [gpui]
    # GPUI lives in the Zed repository.
    repository = "https://github.com/zed-industries/zed.git"
    # Exact commit the GPUI crates are taken from.
    rev = "6b720973027999bae402df23d469026f4cced988"
    # Version of the gpui crate at that commit.
    crate_version = "0.2.2"
    
    [rust]
    # Toolchain used by every crate in the workspace.
    channel = "1.98.1"
    # Host triple the toolchain was installed for.
    host = "x86_64-pc-windows-gnu"
    <# Build the pinned native source with an isolated cache per flavor. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [ValidateSet('stock', 'integration', 'experimental')]
        [string]$Branch = 'integration',
        [ValidateSet('Debug', 'Release')]
        [string]$Profile = 'Release',
        [string]$AzaharRoot,
        [string]$BuildDirectory,
        [switch]$Oracle,
        [int]$Parallel = 4
    )
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
    $root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
    Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Pins.psm1') -Force
    $pins = Read-Pins -Path (Join-Path $root 'config/pins.toml')
    $expected = if ($Branch -eq 'stock') { $pins['azahar']['upstream_commit'] } else { $pins['azahar'][$Branch + '_commit'] }
    if (-not $AzaharRoot) { $AzaharRoot = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $root) ('azahar-' + $Branch) }
    $AzaharRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $AzaharRoot).Path
    $actual = & git -C $AzaharRoot rev-parse HEAD
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $actual -ne $expected) { throw "Source pin mismatch: expected $expected, got $actual" }
    $dirty = & git -C $AzaharRoot status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $dirty) { throw 'Build inputs must be committed and clean' }
    if (-not $BuildDirectory) { $BuildDirectory = Join-Path $root ('build/azahar-' + $Branch + '-native') }
    $BuildDirectory = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($BuildDirectory)
    $cache = Join-Path $BuildDirectory 'CMakeCache.txt'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cache) {
        $source = Select-String -LiteralPath $cache -Pattern '^CMAKE_HOME_DIRECTORY:INTERNAL=(.*)$'
        if (-not $source -or [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($source.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value) -ne $AzaharRoot) {
            throw "Cache belongs to a different source tree: $cache"
        }
    }
    $worker = if ($Branch -eq 'stock') { 'OFF' } else { 'ON' }
    $flags = @('-G', 'Ninja', "-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$Profile", "-DENABLE_CTR_WORKER=$worker",
        '-DCMAKE_PROJECT_citra_INCLUDE=',
        '-DENABLE_QT=OFF', '-DENABLE_LIBRETRO=OFF', '-DENABLE_SDL2=OFF',
        '-DENABLE_WEB_SERVICE=OFF', '-DENABLE_SCRIPTING=OFF', '-DENABLE_ROOM=OFF',
        '-DENABLE_ROOM_STANDALONE=OFF', '-DENABLE_OPENAL=OFF', '-DENABLE_CUBEB=OFF',
        '-DENABLE_LIBUSB=OFF', '-DENABLE_SOFTWARE_RENDERER=ON', '-DENABLE_VULKAN=OFF',
        '-DENABLE_OPENGL=OFF', '-DENABLE_LTO=OFF', '-DCITRA_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=OFF')
    $target = if ($Branch -eq 'stock') { 'citra_core' } else { 'ctr-worker' }
    if ($Branch -ne 'stock') {
        $backendName = if ($Branch -eq 'integration') { 'AZAHAR' } else { 'CITnLO' }
        $flags += "-DCTR_BACKEND_NAME=$backendName"
    }
    if ($Oracle) {
        if ($Branch -ne 'stock') { throw 'The independent oracle must use stock source' }
        $inject = (Join-Path $root 'workers/oracle/inject.cmake').Replace('\', '/')
        $flags += "-DCMAKE_PROJECT_citra_INCLUDE=$inject"
        $target = 'lotus-stock-oracle'
    }
    & cmake -S $AzaharRoot -B $BuildDirectory @flags
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native configuration failed' }
    & cmake --build $BuildDirectory --target $target --parallel $Parallel
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native build failed' }
    @{ source = $actual; branch = $Branch; source_root = $AzaharRoot; target = $target;
       cmake_flags = $flags; compiler = (& g++ --version | Select-Object -First 1);
       host = [System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation]::OSDescription
    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content (Join-Path $BuildDirectory 'lotus-build-manifest.json')

    //! Smoke test for the command line interface.
    //!
    //! The CLI is the headless entry point of the project. It must run without a
    //! GUI session and it must report the pinned revisions.
    
    use std::process::Command;
    
    fn cli() -> Command {
        Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_ctr-cli"))
    }
    
    #[test]
    fn version_reports_the_protocol_version() {
        let output = cli().arg("version").output().expect("cannot run ctr-cli");
        assert!(output.status.success());
        let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
        assert!(
            stdout.contains("worker protocol 1.0"),
            "unexpected output: {stdout}"
        );
    }
    
    #[test]
    fn pins_reports_the_pinned_revisions() {
        let output = cli().arg("pins").output().expect("cannot run ctr-cli");
        assert!(output.status.success());
        let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
        assert!(stdout.contains("azahar"), "unexpected output: {stdout}");
        assert!(stdout.contains("gpui"), "unexpected output: {stdout}");
    }
    
    #[test]
    fn unknown_commands_fail() {
        let output = cli()
            .arg("definitely-not-a-command")
            .output()
            .expect("cannot run ctr-cli");
        assert!(!output.status.success());
    }

    name: citra-build
    
    on:
      push:
        branches: [ "*" ]
        tags: [ "*" ]
      pull_request:
        branches: [ master ]
    
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
      attestations: write
    
    jobs:
      source:
        if: ${{ !github.head_ref }}
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v6
            with:
              submodules: recursive
          - name: Pack
            run: ./.ci/source.sh
          - name: Generate SBOM
            if: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' }}
            uses: anchore/sbom-action@v0
            with:
              path: ./
              format: spdx-json
              output-file: artifacts/source.spdx.json
              upload-artifact: false
          - name: Upload
            uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
            with:
              name: source
              path: artifacts/
          - name: Attest artifacts
            if: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' }}
            uses: actions/attest@v4
            with:
              subject-path: |
                artifacts/*.tar.xz
              sbom-path: artifacts/source.spdx.json
    
      linux-x86_64:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        strategy:
          fail-fast: false
          matrix:
            target: ["appimage", "gcc-nopch"]
        container:
          image: opensauce04/azahar-build-environment:latest
          options: -u 1001
        env:
          CCACHE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.ccache
          CCACHE_COMPILERCHECK: content
          CCACHE_SLOPPINESS: time_macros
          OS: linux
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          CACHE_ENABLED: ${{ github.ref_type != 'tag' }}
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@v6
            with:
              submodules: recursive
          - name: Set up cache
            if: ${{ env.CACHE_ENABLED == 'true' }}
            uses: actions/cache@v5
            with:
              path: ${{ env.CCACHE_DIR }}
              key: ${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ github.sha }}
              restore-keys: |
                ${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.target }}-
          - name: Build
            run: ./.ci/linux.sh
          - name: Move AppImage to artifacts directory
            if: ${{ matrix.target == 'appimage' }}
            run: |
              mkdir -p artifacts
              mv build/bundle/*.AppImage artifacts/

    mod shader_compilation {
        use std::{
            fs,
            io::Write,
            path::{Path, PathBuf},
            process::{self, Command},
        };
    
        pub fn compile_shaders() {
            let shader_path =
                PathBuf::from(std::env::var("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR").unwrap()).join("src/shaders.hlsl");
            let out_dir = std::env::var("OUT_DIR").unwrap();
    
            println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", shader_path.display());
    
            // Check if fxc.exe is available
            let fxc_path = find_fxc_compiler();

            let modules = [
                "quad",
                "opaque_quad",
                "shadow",
                "path_tile",
                "underline",
                "monochrome_sprite",
                "subpixel_sprite",
                "polychrome_sprite",
            ];
    
            let rust_binding_path = format!("{}/shaders_bytes.rs", out_dir);
            if Path::new(&rust_binding_path).exists() {
                fs::remove_file(&rust_binding_path)
                    .expect("Failed to remove existing Rust binding file");

            for module in modules {
                compile_shader_for_module(
                    module,
                    &out_dir,
                    &fxc_path,
                    shader_path.to_str().unwrap(),
                    &rust_binding_path,
                );
            }
        }
    
        /// Locate `binary` in the newest installed Windows SDK.
        pub fn find_latest_windows_sdk_binary(
            binary: &str,
        ) -> Result<Option<PathBuf>, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
            let key = windows_registry::LOCAL_MACHINE
                .open("SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Microsoft SDKs\\Windows\\v10.0")?;
    
            let install_folder: String = key.get_string("InstallationFolder")?; // "C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\"
            let install_folder_bin = Path::new(&install_folder).join("bin");
    
            let mut versions: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(&install_folder_bin)?
                .flatten()
                .filter(|entry| entry.path().is_dir())
                .filter_map(|entry| entry.file_name().into_string().ok())
                .collect();
    
            versions.sort_by_key(|s| {
                s.split('.')
                    .filter_map(|p| p.parse().ok())
                    .collect::<Vec<u32>>()
            });
    
            let arch = match std::env::consts::ARCH {
                "x86_64" => "x64",
                "aarch64" => "arm64",
                _ => Err(format!(
                    "Unsupported architecture: {}",
                    std::env::consts::ARCH
                ))?,
            };
    
            if let Some(highest_version) = versions.last() {
                return Ok(Some(
                    install_folder_bin
                        .join(highest_version)
                        .join(arch)
                        .join(binary),
                ));
            }
    
            Ok(None)
        }
    
        /// You can set the `GPUI_FXC_PATH` environment variable to specify the path to the fxc.exe compiler.
        fn find_fxc_compiler() -> String {
            // Check environment variable
            if let Ok(path) = std::env::var("GPUI_FXC_PATH")
                && Path::new(&path).exists()
            {
                return path;
            }
    
            // Try to find in PATH
            // NOTE: This has to be `where.exe` on Windows, not `where`, it must be ended with `.exe`
            if let Ok(output) = std::process::Command::new("where.exe")
                .arg("fxc.exe")
                .output()
                && output.status.success()
            {
                let path = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
                return path.trim().to_string();
            }
    
            if let Ok(Some(path)) = find_latest_windows_sdk_binary("fxc.exe") {
                return path.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
            }
    
            panic!("Failed to find fxc.exe");
        }
    
        fn compile_shader_for_module(
            module: &str,
            out_dir: &str,
            fxc_path: &str,
            shader_path: &str,
            rust_binding_path: &str,
        ) {
            // Compile vertex shader
            let output_file = format!("{}/{}_vs.h", out_dir, module);
            let const_name = format!("{}_VERTEX_BYTES", module.to_uppercase());
            compile_shader_impl(
                fxc_path,
                &format!("{module}_vertex"),
                &output_file,
                &const_name,
                shader_path,
                "vs_4_1",
            );
            generate_rust_binding(&const_name, &output_file, rust_binding_path);
    
            // Compile fragment shader
            let output_file = format!("{}/{}_ps.h", out_dir, module);
            let const_name = format!("{}_FRAGMENT_BYTES", module.to_uppercase());
            compile_shader_impl(
                fxc_path,
                &format!("{module}_fragment"),
                &output_file,
                &const_name,
                shader_path,
                "ps_4_1",
            );
            generate_rust_binding(&const_name, &output_file, rust_binding_path);
        }
    
        fn compile_shader_impl(
            fxc_path: &str,
            entry_point: &str,
            output_path: &str,
            var_name: &str,
            shader_path: &str,
            target: &str,
        ) {
            let output = Command::new(fxc_path)
                .args([
                    "/T",
                    target,
                    "/E",
                    entry_point,
                    "/Fh",
                    output_path,
                    "/Vn",
                    var_name,
                    "/O3",
                    shader_path,
                ])
                .output();
    
            match output {
                Ok(result) => {
                    if result.status.success() {
                        return;
                    }
                    println!(
                        "cargo::error=Shader compilation failed for {}:\n{}",
                        entry_point,
                        String::from_utf8_lossy(&result.stderr)
                    );
                    process::exit(1);
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    println!("cargo::error=Failed to run fxc for {}: {}", entry_point, e);
                    process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }
    
        fn generate_rust_binding(const_name: &str, head_file: &str, output_path: &str) {
            let header_content = fs::read_to_string(head_file).expect("Failed to read header file");
            let const_definition = {
                let global_var_start = header_content.find("const BYTE").unwrap();
                let global_var = &header_content[global_var_start..];
                let equal = global_var.find('=').unwrap();
                global_var[equal + 1..].trim()
            };
            let rust_binding = format!(
                "const {}: &[u8] = &{}\n",
                const_name,
                const_definition.replace('{', "[").replace('}', "]")
            );
            let mut options = fs::OpenOptions::new()
                .create(true)
                .append(true)
                .open(output_path)
                .expect("Failed to open Rust binding file");
            options
                .write_all(rust_binding.as_bytes())
                .expect("Failed to write Rust binding file");
        }
    }

    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
        Prepares a checkout for development.
    
    .DESCRIPTION
        Installs the pinned Rust toolchain, fetches the pinned vendored sources
        and the Cargo dependencies, and verifies that every pin still matches.
    
        Safe to run repeatedly.
    #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [switch]$SkipSubmodules,
        [switch]$SkipFetch
    )
    
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
    if (Get-Variable -Name PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
        $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
    }
    $root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
    Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Pins.psm1') -Force
    
    $pins = Read-Pins -Path (Join-Path $root 'config\pins.toml')
    
    Write-Host '==> Rust toolchain' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $channel = $pins['rust']['channel']
    $toolchain = (& rustup toolchain list) -join "`n"
    if ($toolchain -notmatch [regex]::Escape($channel)) {
        & rustup toolchain install $channel --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Error "cannot install the pinned toolchain $channel"
        }
    } else {
        Write-Host "toolchain $channel is installed"
    }
    
    if (-not $SkipSubmodules) {
        Write-Host '==> Vendored sources' -ForegroundColor Cyan
        & git -C $root submodule update --init --recursive
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Error 'cannot update the git submodules'
        }
    }
    
    if (-not $SkipFetch) {
        Write-Host '==> Cargo dependencies' -ForegroundColor Cyan
        & cargo fetch --manifest-path (Join-Path $root 'Cargo.toml')
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Error 'cannot fetch the Cargo dependencies'
        }
    }
    
    Write-Host '==> Pin verification' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'verify-pins.ps1')
    exit $LASTEXITCODE

    Add: C:\Users\julie\workdir\3DS\lotus\packaging\windows\README.txt
    LOTUS portable for Windows x64
    
    Extract the entire ZIP to a writable folder, then double-click LOTUS.cmd.
    Select your own .3dsx homebrew. In LOTUS, click New: homebrew, then Run.
    LOTUS.cmd uses CITnLO. LOTUS-AZAHAR.cmd uses the upstream-tracking AZAHAR backend.
    You can also drag a .3dsx onto either launcher.
    
    No installer, administrator access, Rust, compiler or Python is required to run.
    Windows 11 x64 is the initial supported host; the GPUI desktop uses Direct3D 11.
    Keep all files together. Sessions, logs and saves live in data/<backend>/sessions.
    Move the entire folder to move the installation. Select the homebrew again after
    moving: the launcher refreshes machine-specific asset/runtime paths each time.
    Closing LOTUS terminates its workers. Keep data/ when upgrading to retain runs.
    
    bin/ctr-cli.exe provides headless scenario runs. bin/lotus-mcp.exe serves local
    MCP over stdio using an explicit host JSON. For a portable MCP command:
    powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File <folder>/launch.ps1 -Mode MCP -Fixture <homebrew.3dsx>
    MCP and desktop are separate hosts; each owns its sessions. No network listener.
    
    This initial developer release is unsigned. Software rendering only; audio is
    muted. No ROMs, Nintendo firmware, DSP dump, keys or user captures are included.
    Visible GPUI/input and actual two-DPI acceptance remain unverified. Automated
    native lifecycle, isolation, protocol, CLI and MCP checks are documented in docs/.
    No hardware accuracy claim is made. Licenses and exact source/build revisions
    are in licenses/, SOURCE.md and release-manifest.json. No telemetry or updater.

    <# Portable desktop/MCP launcher. All runtime files stay beside this script. #>
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [ValidateSet('CITnLO', 'AZAHAR')][string]$Backend = 'CITnLO',
        [ValidateSet('Desktop', 'MCP')][string]$Mode = 'Desktop',
        [Parameter(Position = 0)][string]$Fixture,
        [switch]$ConfigureOnly
    )
    $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
    if (-not $Fixture) {
        if ($Mode -eq 'MCP' -or $ConfigureOnly) { throw 'Supply -Fixture with a local .3dsx path' }
        Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
        $dialog = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.OpenFileDialog
        $dialog.Title = 'Open homebrew in LOTUS'
        $dialog.Filter = '3DS homebrew (*.3dsx)|*.3dsx'
        try {
            if ($dialog.ShowDialog() -ne [System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult]::OK) { exit 0 }
            $Fixture = $dialog.FileName
        } finally { $dialog.Dispose() }
    }
    $content = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Fixture).Path
    if ([IO.Path]::GetExtension($content) -ine '.3dsx') { throw 'Select a .3dsx homebrew file' }
    $data = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot ('data/' + $Backend.ToLowerInvariant())
    [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($data) | Out-Null
    $config = Join-Path $data 'host.json'
    $text = @{
        worker = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot ('runtimes/' + $Backend.ToLowerInvariant() + '/ctr-worker.exe')
        storage_root = Join-Path $data 'sessions'
        assets = @{ homebrew = $content }
        allow_control = $true
    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
    # Windows PowerShell's default UTF-8 includes a BOM; serde_json expects plain UTF-8.
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($config, $text, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    if ($ConfigureOnly) { return }
    if ($Mode -eq 'MCP') {
        & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'bin/lotus-mcp.exe') $config
    } else {
        & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'bin/lotus-desktop.exe') $config
    }
    exit $LASTEXITCODE

    """Archive committed LOTUS and recursive native submodule sources, without user data."""
    import argparse
    from pathlib import Path
    import shutil
    import subprocess
    import tarfile
    import zipfile
    
    
    def archive(destination, repository, revision, prefix):
        process = subprocess.Popen(["git", "-C", str(repository), "archive", "--format=tar", revision],
                                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=process.stdout, mode="r|") as source:
            for member in source:
                if member.isfile():
                    with source.extractfile(member) as content, destination.open(prefix + member.name, "w") as output:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(content, output)
        if process.wait() != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Source archive failed: {repository}")
        tree = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repository), "ls-tree", "-r", "-z", revision])
        for entry in tree.split(b"\0"):
            if entry.startswith(b"160000 "):
                metadata, name = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
                path = name.decode("utf-8")
                archive(destination, repository / path, metadata.split()[2].decode(), prefix + path + "/")
    
    
    def main():
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
        args = parser.parse_args()
        if args.output.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(args.output)
        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        with zipfile.ZipFile(args.output, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as destination:
            archive(destination, root, "HEAD", "LOTUS-source/")
        print(args.output)
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()

    """Fetch verified, private build tools; never install into Windows directories."""
    import argparse
    import hashlib
    from pathlib import Path
    import urllib.request
    import zipfile
    
    WINLIBS = (
        "https://github.com/brechtsanders/winlibs_mingw/releases/download/"
        "16.2.0posix-14.0.0-ucrt-r2/winlibs-x86_64-posix-seh-gcc-16.2.0-mingw-w64ucrt-14.0.0-r2.zip",
        "d5dbafc4a170e762ca6143151ec918fb9e2c72736fb14cd704abebc6bdd5276a",
    )
    SDK = (
        "https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/microsoft.windows.sdk.cpp/10.0.28000.2705/"
        "microsoft.windows.sdk.cpp.10.0.28000.2705.nupkg",
        "a74ca8f9af98bd61925d9e2932ad98f746306123167b8f0bba99cd9ea9f03807",
    )
    
    
    def fetch(root, name, source):
        path = root / name
        if not path.exists():
            urllib.request.urlretrieve(source[0], path)
        if hashlib.file_digest(path.open("rb"), "sha256").hexdigest() != source[1]:
            raise ValueError(f"Build-tool checksum mismatch: {path}")
        return path
    
    
    def main():
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
        parser.add_argument("--sdk-only", action="store_true")
        args = parser.parse_args()
        args.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if not args.sdk_only:
            archive = fetch(args.root, "winlibs.zip", WINLIBS)
            if not (args.root / "winlibs/mingw64/bin/g++.exe").exists():
                with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as source:
                    source.extractall(args.root / "winlibs")
        archive = fetch(args.root, "windows-sdk.nupkg", SDK)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as source:
            for name in ("fxc.exe", "d3dcompiler_47.dll"):
                source.extract(f"c/bin/10.0.28000.0/x64/{name}", args.root / "sdk")
        print(args.root.resolve())
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()

    """Stage and assemble portable x64 builds; fail on unresolved non-system DLLs."""
    import argparse
    import hashlib
    import json
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import re
    import shutil
    import struct
    import subprocess
    import tomllib
    import zipfile
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    LICENSE = re.compile(r"^(licen[cs]e|copying|notice|copyright|authors|patents)", re.I)
    
    
    def write_json(path, value):
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    
    
    def digest(path):
        with path.open("rb") as source:
            return hashlib.file_digest(source, "sha256").hexdigest()
    
    
    def imports(path):
        """Read normal/delay PE imports. Only AMD64 PE32+ binaries belong in this ZIP."""
        data = path.read_bytes()
        pe, = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 0x3C)
        if data[:2] != b"MZ" or data[pe:pe + 4] != b"PE\0\0":
            raise ValueError(f"Not a Windows executable: {path}")
        machine, count = struct.unpack_from("<HH", data, pe + 4)
        optional = pe + 24
        optional_size, = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, pe + 20)
        magic, = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, optional)
        if (machine, magic) != (0x8664, 0x20B):
            raise ValueError(f"Not Windows x64: {path}")
        sections = []
        for index in range(count):
            offset = optional + optional_size + 40 * index
            virtual_size, rva, raw_size, raw = struct.unpack_from("<IIII", data, offset + 8)
            sections.append((rva, max(virtual_size, raw_size), raw, raw_size))
    
        def locate(rva):
            for start, size, raw, raw_size in sections:
                if start <= rva < start + size and rva - start < raw_size:
                    return raw + rva - start
            raise ValueError(f"Unmapped PE RVA {rva:x}: {path}")
    
        def name(rva):
            offset = locate(rva)
            end = data.index(0, offset, offset + 512)
            result = data[offset:end].decode("ascii")
            if not re.fullmatch(r"[\w.+-]+\.dll", result, re.I):
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid DLL name: {result}")
            return result.lower()
    
        result = set()
        rva, size = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, optional + 112 + 8)
        if rva:
            offset = locate(rva)
            for step in range(0, size, 20):
                fields = struct.unpack_from("<IIIII", data, offset + step)
                if not any(fields):
                    break
                result.add(name(fields[3]))
        rva, size = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, optional + 112 + 13 * 8)
        if rva:
            offset = locate(rva)
            base, = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, optional + 24)
            for step in range(0, size, 32):
                fields = struct.unpack_from("<8I", data, offset + step)
                if not any(fields):
                    break
                result.add(name(fields[1] if fields[0] & 1 else fields[1] - base))
        return sorted(result)
    
    
    def copy_binaries(executables, destination, search):
        destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        system = Path(os.environ["SystemRoot"]) / "System32"
        records = {}
        pending = [(path, destination / path.name) for path in executables]
        while pending:
            source, target = pending.pop()
            if target.name.lower() in records:
                if digest(source) != digest(target):
                    raise ValueError(f"Conflicting runtime DLL: {target.name}")
                continue
            shutil.copy2(source, target)
            dependencies = imports(target)
            records[target.name.lower()] = dependencies
            for dependency in dependencies:
                if dependency.startswith(("api-ms-", "ext-ms-")) or (system / dependency).is_file():
                    continue
                found = next((folder / dependency for folder in [source.parent, *search]
                              if (folder / dependency).is_file()), None)
                if found is None:
                    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing {dependency}, required by {source.name}")
                if dependency == "msys-2.0.dll":
                    raise ValueError("MSYS runtime must not enter a native portable build")
                pending.append((found, destination / dependency))
        return records
    
    
    def copy_licenses(source, destination, recursive=True):
        count = 0
        for directory, folders, files in os.walk(source):
            folders[:] = [name for name in folders if name not in (".git", "target", "build")]
            for filename in files:
                if LICENSE.match(filename):
                    path = Path(directory) / filename
                    target = destination / path.relative_to(source)
                    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    shutil.copy2(path, target)
                    count += 1
            if not recursive:
                break
        return count
    
    
    def stage_rust(args):
        binaries = [args.binary_dir / f"{name}.exe" for name in ("lotus-desktop", "ctr-cli", "lotus-mcp")]
        dependencies = copy_binaries(binaries, args.output / "bin", args.dll_dir)
        metadata = json.loads(args.metadata.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        notices = []
        for package in metadata["packages"]:
            if package["source"] is None:
                continue
            source = Path(package["manifest_path"]).parent
            target = args.output / "licenses/rust" / f"{package['name']}-{package['version']}"
            copied = copy_licenses(source, target, recursive=False)
            # Workspace packages (GPUI) inherit the repository's licenses.
            for parent in source.parents:
                if (parent / ".git").exists():
                    copied += copy_licenses(parent, target / "repository", recursive=False)
                    break
            if package.get("license_file"):
                path = source / package["license_file"]
                if path.is_file():
                    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    shutil.copy2(path, target / path.name)
                    copied += 1
            if not copied:
                for filename in ("README.md", "README", "Readme.md"):
                    if (source / filename).is_file():
                        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                        shutil.copy2(source / filename, target / filename)
                        break
            notices.append({key: package.get(key) for key in ("name", "version", "license", "repository", "source")})
        sysroot = Path(subprocess.check_output(["rustc", "--print", "sysroot"], text=True).strip())
        copy_licenses(sysroot / "share/doc/rust", args.output / "licenses/rust-toolchain")
        for directory in args.dll_dir:
            copy_licenses(directory.parent, args.output / "licenses/mingw")
        write_json(args.output / "licenses/rust-packages.json", notices)
        write_json(args.output / "rust-build.json", {
            "rustc": subprocess.check_output(["rustc", "-Vv"], text=True).strip(),
            "cargo": subprocess.check_output(["cargo", "-V"], text=True).strip(),
            "profile": "release", "target": "x86_64-pc-windows-gnu",
            "lto": "thin", "codegen_units": 1, "panic": "abort", "imports": dependencies,
        })
    
    
    def stage_runtime(args):
        dependencies = copy_binaries([args.build / "bin/Release/ctr-worker.exe"], args.output, args.dll_dir)
        manifest = json.loads((args.build / "lotus-build-manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        manifest.pop("source_root", None)
        manifest["imports"] = dependencies
        write_json(args.output / "build-manifest.json", manifest)
        for directory in args.dll_dir:
            copy_licenses(directory.parent, args.output / "licenses/mingw")
    
    
    def assemble(args):
        pins = tomllib.loads((ROOT / "config/pins.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        version = tomllib.loads((ROOT / "Cargo.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["workspace"]["package"]["version"]
        if args.version != version:
            raise ValueError(f"Requested {args.version}; Cargo version is {version}")
        name = f"LOTUS-v{version}-windows-x64"
        destination = args.output / name
        destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        shutil.copytree(ROOT / "packaging/windows", destination, dirs_exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copytree(args.rust, destination, dirs_exist_ok=True)
        for backend, source, branch in (("azahar", args.azahar, "integration"), ("citnlo", args.citnlo, "experimental")):
            manifest = json.loads((source / "build-manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if manifest["source"] != pins["azahar"][f"{branch}_commit"] or manifest["branch"] != branch:
                raise ValueError(f"Wrong source/flavor for {backend}")
            expected_name = "CITnLO" if backend == "citnlo" else "AZAHAR"
            if f"-DCTR_BACKEND_NAME={expected_name}" not in manifest["cmake_flags"]:
                raise ValueError(f"Wrong backend identity for {backend}")
            shutil.copytree(source, destination / "runtimes" / backend)
        shutil.copy2(ROOT / "LICENSE", destination / "LICENSE")
        shutil.copytree(ROOT / "docs", destination / "docs", ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("index.md", "glossary.md"))
        # Source archives and notices contain only tracked upstream inputs, never instance roots.
        copy_licenses(ROOT / "vendor/azahar", destination / "licenses/azahar")
        source_sha = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
        (destination / "SOURCE.md").write_text(
            f"# Corresponding source\n\nLOTUS {version}: https://github.com/estyseesghosts/lotus/tree/{source_sha}\n\n"
            f"AZAHAR / CITnLO: https://github.com/estyseesghosts/azahar/tree/{pins['azahar']['integration_commit']}\n\n"
            f"GPUI: https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/tree/{pins['gpui']['rev']}\n\n"
            "The release also includes a recursive LOTUS/native source ZIP. For a Git build, clone\n"
            "the LOTUS release tag with --recurse-submodules; see docs/26-portable-release.md.\n"
            "Rust dependency versions/sources are fixed by Cargo.lock; licenses/rust-packages.json\n"
            "records their SPDX licenses and source identifiers. Native dependencies are included\n"
            "in the recursive source ZIP. Build tools are not required to run this application.\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        files = {path.relative_to(destination).as_posix(): digest(path)
                 for path in sorted(destination.rglob("*")) if path.is_file()}
        write_json(destination / "release-manifest.json", {
            "application": "LOTUS", "version": version, "source": source_sha,
            "target": "windows-x64", "native_pins": pins["azahar"], "gpui": pins["gpui"],
            "files_sha256": files,
        })
        output = args.output / f"{name}.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(output, "x", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as archive:
            for path in sorted(destination.rglob("*")):
                if path.is_file():
                    archive.write(path, path.relative_to(args.output))
        print(output)
    
    
    def main():
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
        rust = commands.add_parser("rust")
        rust.add_argument("--binary-dir", type=Path, required=True)
        rust.add_argument("--metadata", type=Path, required=True)
        runtime = commands.add_parser("runtime")
        runtime.add_argument("--build", type=Path, required=True)
        for command in (rust, runtime):
            command.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
            command.add_argument("--dll-dir", type=Path, action="append", default=[])
        package = commands.add_parser("assemble")
        for name in ("rust", "azahar", "citnlo", "output"):
            package.add_argument(f"--{name}", type=Path, required=True)
        package.add_argument("--version", required=True)
        args = parser.parse_args()
        {"rust": stage_rust, "runtime": stage_runtime, "assemble": assemble}[args.command](args)
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()

    # Portable Windows release
    
    `LOTUS-v0.0.1-windows-x64.zip` contains the desktop, CLI, MCP server and separate
    AZAHAR/CITnLO runtimes. Extract it into a writable folder. `LOTUS.cmd` selects
    homebrew using a Windows file dialog and launches CITnLO; `LOTUS-AZAHAR.cmd`
    selects AZAHAR. Both recreate absolute host configuration from the installation
    location, retaining sessions under `data/<backend>/sessions`. No installer,
    registry changes or developer tools are required. Windows 11 x64 / Direct3D 11
    is the initial target. The binaries are unsigned.
    
    The packager reads AMD64 PE imports, copies non-system DLLs recursively, and
    rejects missing dependencies or MSYS runtime dependencies. Windows system/API-set
    DLLs stay supplied by Windows. All payload files have SHA-256 entries in
    `release-manifest.json`; the release also supplies ZIP checksums, notices and a
    recursive LOTUS/native source ZIP. Guest assets and instance directories are
    excluded. Only the three production Rust executables are shipped.
    
    Build from a recursive Git checkout of the release tag. `scripts/setup-build-tools.py`
    downloads hash-verified WinLibs GCC 16.2.0 r2 (including CMake/Ninja) and Windows
    SDK 10.0.28000.2705 shader tools into a private build directory. Add
    `<tools>/winlibs/mingw64/bin` to PATH and set `GPUI_FXC_PATH` to
    `<tools>/sdk/c/bin/10.0.28000.0/x64/fxc.exe`. GPUI's pinned
    `crates/gpui_windows/build.rs` requires FXC for optimized shader compilation.
    The SDK is a build dependency, not part of the runtime ZIP.
    
    The exact build, staging and packaging commands are in
    [windows.yml](../.github/workflows/windows.yml). CI runs on pushes to main,
    pull requests, tags and manual dispatch: Rust formatting/Clippy/release tests;
    independent pinned native builds; native framing/self-tests; package assembly;
    relocation to a path containing spaces with a Windows-only PATH; DLL/hash,
    launcher, CLI, MCP and native startup checks. No supplied private fixture runs
    on GitHub. Tag `v<version>` must match Cargo's workspace version and publishes
    only after all build and package jobs pass. Actions and build-tool downloads are
    pinned; per-runtime manifests record source/flags/compiler. GitHub's Windows
    runner image is maintained externally, so byte-identical rebuilds are not promised.
    
    Local native fixture results and stock comparisons remain in
    [25](25-wave-status.md). Visible GPUI/input and actual two-DPI checks are still
    deferred at the user's instruction. Audio playback and hardware accuracy are not
    claimed. Rollback is extracting an earlier ZIP; preserve `data/` when upgrading.
    
    Corresponding source: the tag's LOTUS tree, pinned fork commits and recursive
    submodules, plus Cargo.lock's exact Rust sources. The source ZIP excludes Git
    metadata; use `git clone --branch v0.0.1 --recurse-submodules
    https://github.com/estyseesghosts/lotus.git` for the Git-based build scripts.

    """Verify ZIP relocation and startup with a Windows-only PATH, without guest assets."""
    import importlib.util
    import json
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import tempfile
    import zipfile
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("package_windows", ROOT / "scripts/package-windows.py")
    packaging = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(packaging)
    
    
    def main():
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="LOTUS portable ") as temporary:
            relocated = Path(temporary) / "Moved installation"
            with zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]) as archive:
                archive.extractall(relocated)
            roots = list(relocated.iterdir())
            assert len(roots) == 1 and roots[0].is_dir()
            root = roots[0]
            manifest = json.loads((root / "release-manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            for name, digest in manifest["files_sha256"].items():
                assert packaging.digest(root / name) == digest, name
            for path in root.rglob("*"):
                assert path.suffix.lower() not in (".3dsx", ".3ds", ".cdc", ".log"), path
                if path.suffix.lower() in (".exe", ".dll"):
                    for dependency in packaging.imports(path):
                        assert (dependency.startswith(("api-ms-", "ext-ms-"))
                                or (path.parent / dependency).exists()
                                or (Path(os.environ["SystemRoot"]) / "System32" / dependency).exists()), dependency
            environment = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
                           if not key.startswith(("LOTUS_", "CARGO_", "RUST"))}
            environment["PATH"] = os.pathsep.join([
                str(Path(os.environ["SystemRoot"]) / "System32"), os.environ["SystemRoot"]])
    
            def run(*command):
                return subprocess.run(command, cwd=temporary, env=environment, capture_output=True,
                                      text=True, encoding="utf-8", check=True, timeout=30)
    
            version = run(str(root / "bin/ctr-cli.exe"), "version").stdout
            assert f"lotus {manifest['version']}" in version
            # The file is only a launcher path fixture; it is never emulated.
            fixture = Path(temporary) / "homebrew path with spaces.3dsx"
            fixture.write_bytes(b"")
            for backend, branch in (("azahar", "integration"), ("citnlo", "experimental")):
                worker = root / "runtimes" / backend / "ctr-worker.exe"
                assert manifest["native_pins"][f"{branch}_commit"] in run(str(worker), "--version").stdout
                run(str(worker), "--probe-core")
                assert "=ok" in run(str(worker), "--self-test").stdout
                # Exercise Windows PowerShell 5.1, the version invoked by the .cmd launchers.
                run("powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File",
                    str(root / "launch.ps1"), "-Backend", backend.upper() if backend == "azahar" else "CITnLO",
                    "-Fixture", str(fixture), "-ConfigureOnly")
                config = json.loads((root / "data" / backend / "host.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                assert Path(config["worker"]) == worker
                assert Path(config["assets"]["homebrew"]) == fixture
                assert Path(config["storage_root"]).is_relative_to(root)
                subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "tests/test_native_protocol.py"), str(worker)],
                               cwd=temporary, env=environment, check=True, timeout=60)
            server = subprocess.run([str(root / "bin/lotus-mcp.exe")], input="", cwd=temporary,
                                    env=environment, capture_output=True, timeout=10)
            assert server.returncode == 0, server.stderr
        print("Portable relocation, checksums, DLL closure, launch paths and CLI/MCP/native startup: passed")
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()
