        server, config, asset = sys.argv[1:]
        messages = queue.Queue()
        flags = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if sys.platform == "win32" else 0
        with subprocess.Popen([server, config], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                              stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True, encoding="utf-8",
                              creationflags=flags) as process:
            def read():
                for line in process.stdout:
                    messages.put(json.loads(line))
                messages.put(None)
            threading.Thread(target=read, daemon=True).start()
            request_id = 0
    
            def send(method, params=None, notification=False):
                nonlocal request_id
                request_id += 1
                message = {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": method}
                if not notification:
                    message["id"] = request_id
                if params is not None:
                    message["params"] = params
                process.stdin.write(json.dumps(message) + "\n")
                process.stdin.flush()
                if notification:
                    return None
                deadline = time.monotonic() + 35
                while True:
                    reply = messages.get(timeout=max(0.001, deadline - time.monotonic()))
                    assert reply is not None, "server exited early"
                    if reply.get("id") == request_id:
                        assert "error" not in reply, reply
                        return reply["result"]
    
            def tool(name, arguments):
                result = send("tools/call", {"name": name, "arguments": arguments})
                assert not result.get("isError", False), result
                return result
    
            try:
                send("initialize", {"protocolVersion": "2025-03-26", "capabilities": {},
                                    "clientInfo": {"name": "lotus-local-acceptance", "version": "1"}})
                send("notifications/initialized", notification=True)
                names = {entry["name"] for entry in send("tools/list")["tools"]}
                assert {"lotus_create_session", "lotus_run_until", "lotus_capture", "lotus_input"} <= names
                created = tool("lotus_create_session", {"asset": asset})
                session = json.loads(created["content"][0]["text"])["session"]
                tool("lotus_run_until", {"session": session, "frames": 60})
                capture = tool("lotus_capture", {"session": session})
                assert len(capture["content"]) == 2
                for link in capture["content"]:
                    assert link["type"] == "resource_link"
                    resource = send("resources/read", {"uri": link["uri"]})
                    data = base64.b64decode(resource["contents"][0]["blob"], validate=True)
                    assert len(data) == link["size"]
                assert len(send("resources/list")["resources"]) == 2
                denied = send("tools/call", {"name": "lotus_create_session", "arguments": {"asset": "../../arbitrary.3dsx"}})
                assert denied.get("isError")
                tool("lotus_control", {"session": session, "operation": "stop"})
                process.stdin.close()
                process.wait(timeout=5)
                assert process.returncode == 0
                print("MCP stdio/native lifecycle/resources/permissions: passed")
            finally:
                if process.poll() is None:
                    process.kill()
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()

    name: Windows portable
    
    on:
      push:
        branches: [main]
        tags: ['v*']
      pull_request:
      workflow_dispatch:
    
    permissions:
      contents: read
    
    concurrency:
      group: windows-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref_type != 'tag' }}
    
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
    
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
    
    jobs:
      rust:
        runs-on: windows-2025
        timeout-minutes: 90
        steps:
          - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
            with:
              persist-credentials: false
          - uses: actions/setup-python@ece7cb06caefa5fff74198d8649806c4678c61a1 # v6
            with:
              python-version: '3.14'
          - name: Build tools
            run: |
              python scripts/setup-build-tools.py build/tools
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
              "${{ github.workspace }}\build\tools\winlibs\mingw64\bin" >> $env:GITHUB_PATH
              "GPUI_FXC_PATH=${{ github.workspace }}\build\tools\sdk\c\bin\10.0.28000.0\x64\fxc.exe" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
              rustup toolchain install 1.98.1-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          - uses: actions/cache@caa296126883cff596d87d8935842f9db880ef25 # v5
            with:
              path: |
                ~/.cargo/registry
                ~/.cargo/git
                target
              key: windows-gnu-release-v1-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock', 'rust-toolchain.toml') }}
              restore-keys: windows-gnu-release-v1-
          - name: Check and build
            run: |
              cargo fmt --all -- --check
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
              cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
              cargo build --locked --release --bins
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
              cargo test --locked --release --workspace
              exit $LASTEXITCODE
          - name: Stage applications and notices

    Add: C:\Users\julie\workdir\3DS\lotus\scripts\validate-build-reuse.py
    """Permit packaging-only recovery from trusted main builds with unchanged binary inputs."""
    import json
    import os
    import subprocess
    import sys
    
    
    def api(path):
        return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["gh", "api", path]))
    
    
    def main():
        run_id = sys.argv[1]
        if not run_id.isdecimal():
            raise ValueError("Build run must be a numeric GitHub run ID")
        repository = os.environ["GITHUB_REPOSITORY"]
        run = api(f"repos/{repository}/actions/runs/{run_id}")
        if (run["head_repository"]["full_name"] != repository or run["head_branch"] != "main"
                or run["event"] not in ("push", "workflow_dispatch") or run["status"] != "completed"):
            raise ValueError("Reuse requires a completed, trusted main workflow run")
        jobs = api(f"repos/{repository}/actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs?per_page=100")["jobs"]
        for name in ("rust", "native (integration)", "native (experimental)"):
            if not any(job["name"] == name and job["conclusion"] == "success" for job in jobs):
                raise ValueError(f"Missing successful build: {name}")
        difference = api(f"repos/{repository}/compare/{run['head_sha']}...{os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']}")
        if difference["status"] not in ("ahead", "identical"):
            raise ValueError("Build source must be an ancestor of the packaging revision")
        allowed = {"tests/test_portable.py", ".github/workflows/windows.yml", "SHA256SUMS.txt",
                   "scripts/package-windows.py", "scripts/archive-source.py", "scripts/validate-build-reuse.py"}
        files = difference["files"]
        if len(files) >= 300:
            raise ValueError("Comparison may be truncated; rebuild instead")
        for changed in files:
            for name in (changed["filename"], changed.get("previous_filename", changed["filename"])):
                if name not in allowed and not name.startswith(("packaging/", "docs/")):
                    raise ValueError(f"Binary build input changed: {name}; rebuild instead")
        print(f"Reusing tested binaries from {run['head_sha']} (run {run_id}); binary inputs unchanged")
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()
